description: Branches succulent. Leaves: petiole to 4 mm long; blade coriaceous, obovate to linear, 3–17 x 0.2–5 cm apex acute to emarginate and apiculate to mucronate, base cuneate; secondary veins up to 13 pairs; both sides glabrous or pubescent. Inflorescence 1–2.5 cm long. Sepals narrowly oblong to narrowly ovate, 0.5–1.1 x 0.2–0.3 cm; pubescent. Corolla pink to red; tube 2–4.5 cm long; lobes 0.9–2.8 cm long; pubescent or glabrous outside, pubescent inside. Stamens inserted at 0.9–1.7 cm from base; filaments 5–7 mm long; anthers 2–3 x 1 mm, acumen to 15 mm long. Ovary 1.5–2.5 mm long; style + pistil head 9.5–20 mm long. Fruit 11–22 x 0.9–2 cm. Seeds 1–1.4 x 0.2–0.4 cm; coma 2.5–3.5 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenium obesum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 78. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches puberulent when young; older branches sparsely lenticellate or not. Leaves: petiole 0.6–3.2 cm long; blade papery, elliptic to ovate, 2.1–11.3 x 1–4.6 cm, apex acuminate to obtuse, base cuneate to cordate; secondary veins 3–6 pairs; pubescent on the underside in the axils of the secondary veins. Inflorescence 3–9 cm long; puberulent; many flowered; bracts narrowly ovate and early deciduous. Sepals ovate, 1.8–3.5 x 0.9–1.5 mm, apex acute or acuminate; puberulent to glabrous, usually minutely ciliate. Corolla pale yellowish, pinkish or red; tube 3.5–5.2 mm long; lobes 1.5–2.5 mm long; sparsely puberulent to almost glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and sparsely so lower down inside. Stamens with anthers 3.2–4.2 x 0.6–0.7 mm. Disk shorter than the ovary. Ovary 0.9–1.1 mm long; style + pistil head 2 mm long. Fruit 5.5–21 cm long, 4–6 mm wide; glabrous. Seeds brown or white hirsute; elliptic; 10–10.2 x 1.7–3.2 mm; coma 1.5–3.3 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aganonerion polymorphum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 141. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets strigose; lenticellate when older. Leaves: petiole 0.7–1.2 cm long; blade subcoriaceous, elliptic, 5.5–13.5 x 2.2–6.4 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 5–8 pairs, no clear intramarginal nerve; few strigose hairs on midrib beneath and margin at base. Inflorescence 3.1–8 cm long; sparsely tomentose; pedicels 3–10 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 10–12 x 1.5–3.7 mm, apex acuminate; tomentose; few colleters in corners. Corolla white; tube 6.7–10 mm long; lobes 5–8.2 mm long, elliptic, apex acute to acuminate; tomentose outside, pubescent in mouth and in tube. Stamens inserted at 2–3.8 mm from base; anthers 4.4–6 x 0.9–1.1 mm. Disk longer than ovary, narrower at top, 5-dentate; 1.1–2.2 mm long. Ovary 0.9–1.4 mm long; sparsely puberulent; style + pistil head 4.7–6.2 mm long. Fruit unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aganosma breviloba. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 104. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets brown villous to tomentose; older branches sometimes glabrous, lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 0.7–1.5(–2.8) cm long; blade subcoriaceous, elliptic, 4–14.1 x 1.9–9.3 cm, apex acuminate, rarely apiculate or rounded, base cuneate to rounded; secondary veins 6–9 pairs, no clear intramarginal veins; pubescent or glabrate above and below. Inflorescence 2.4–7.3 cm long; densely short brown pubescent; pedicels 2.3–5 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 7.1–13.5 x 1.3–3.1 mm, apex acuminate; tomentose; colleters inside few or absent. Corolla white; tube 4.1–8 mm long; lobes 6.2–12.6 mm long, apex acuminate; tomentose outside, mouth glabrous, pubescent behind and beneath anthers. Stamens inserted at 1–2 mm from base; anthers 4.3–4.9 x 0.7–0.9 mm. Disk longer than the ovary, narrower at top; 5-dentate or annular; 1.2–1.9 mm long. Ovary 0.6–0.8 mm long, glabrous; style + pistil head 2.9–3.9 mm long. Fruit of paired divergent follicles; (8.1–)32–37 cm long, 0.6–0.9 cm wide; villous. Seeds (12.3–)20.5–22.5 x (3.7–)6.5–6.7 mm; glabrous; coma (2.5–)4.8–5.1 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aganosma cymosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 105. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets glabrous or puberulent; branches lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 3.5–12 mm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, oblong, elliptic or slightly obovate, 2.2–10.8 x 0.6–4.7 cm, apex acuminate or apiculate, base cuneate to weakly cordate; secondary veins 8–18 pairs anastomosing into a clear intramarginal nerve; glabrous or puberulent. Inflorescence 4–17 cm long; glabrous or puberulent; pedicels 2.7–8 mm long. Sepals narrowly ovate to lanceolate, 2–6 x 0.8–1.6 mm, apex acute to acuminate; glabrous or puberulent; many colleters inside at base. Corolla white or cream; tube 4.4–8 mm long; lobes 8–17 mm long, long and narrow, apex acute or obtuse; glabrous or puberulent outside, pubescent inside. Stamens inserted at 2.2–3.2 mm from base; anthers 2.5–3.2 x 0.4–0.7 mm. Disk usually shorter than ovary, not narrower at top; 5-lobed; 0.2–0.7 mm long. Ovary 0.4–1.2 mm long, glabrous or, rarely, sparsely and minutely puberulent; style + pistil head 2.7–3.6 mm long. Fruit 28–74 cm long, 0.4–1 cm wide; lenticellate; glabrous. Seeds 8–12 x 1.2–2.3 mm, flattened; coma 2.4–5 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aganosma marginata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 106. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets sparsely strigose to glabrous; lenticellate when older. Leaves: petiole 4.3–17 mm long; blade subcoriaceous, elliptic or, rarely, obovate, 5.4–10.7 x 2.2–4.4 cm, apex acuminate, base acute to rounded; secondary veins 4–10 pairs, no clear intramarginal nerve; few strigose hairs on petiole, otherwise glabrous (sometimes tomentose on non-Thai plants). Inflorescence 2.2–13 cm long; shortly tomentose on upper parts; pedicels 1.8–22 mm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 6.3–15.2 x 1.5–5 mm, apex acuminate; shortly pubescent; colleters only in corners. Corolla white; tube 4.8–12.7 mm long; lobes 4.1–16 mm long, obovate, flat topped; shortly pubescent outside, pubescent in mouth and inside. Stamens inserted at 1.2–3.9 mm from base; anthers 3.8–6.3 x 0.8–1.3 mm. Disk longer than ovary, narrower at top, 5-dentate; 0.9–2.3 mm long. Ovary 0.6–1.6 mm long; sparsely pubesent; style + pistil head 2.6–6.6 mm long. Fruit 10.1–38 cm long, 4–8.6 mm wide; glabrous to tomentose. Seeds 15.5–23 x 2.5–5.6 mm, flattened; coma 2.3–5.5 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aganosma schlechteriana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 106. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches glabrous or with few hairs. Leaves: petiole 0.9–1.5 cm long; blade papery, elliptic or oblong, 6.1–14 x 2–7 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate to rounded; 5–9 pairs of secondary veins, no clear intramarginal nerve; few hairs on petiole, otherwise glabrous. Inflorescence 5.5–10.7 cm long; minutely tomentose in upper parts and with few strigose hairs lower down or glabrous; pedicel 0.5–1.4 cm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 11.5–21 x 1.3–4 mm, apex acuminate; puberulent/tomentose; colleters inside few or absent. Corolla white; tube 1–1.4 cm long; lobes (1.1–)1.6–3.5 cm long, long and narrow, apex acute; outside tomentose, pubescent in mouth and in five rows down tube inside. Stamens inserted at 1.1–2.6 mm from base; anthers 5.2–6.1 x 0.9–1.2 mm. Disk longer than ovary, narrower at top, 5-dentate; 1.4–3 mm long. Ovary 0.7–1.2 mm long, sparsely pubescent; style + pistil head 4.1–4.5 mm. Fruit puberulent; 14.2–16 cm long, 6–8 mm wide.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Branchlets shortly tomentose; older branches lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 0.8–1.5 cm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, elliptic, 6–14.5 x 4.5–8.5 cm, apex acuminate, base acute to weakly cordate; 6–9 pairs of secondary veins, no clear intramarginal nerve; strigose on petiole and base of midrib beneath, otherwise glabrous. Inflorescence 5.5–19.5 cm long; tomentose; pedicels 0.8–1.7 cm long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 1.4–2.3 x 0.2–0.6 cm, apex acuminate to caudate; tomentose; colleters inside few or absent. Corolla white or cream; tube 8.3–14 mm long; lobes 8.8–14.5 mm long; apex flattened, tomentose outside, glabrous in mouth, pubescent behind and beneath anthers inside. Stamens inserted at 2.8–4.5 mm from base; anthers 4.7–6.7 x 1.1–1.4 mm. Disk longer than ovary, narrower at top, 5-dentate; 2–3 mm long. Ovary 0.8–1.3 mm long; sparsely to densely pubescent on top; style + pistil head 4.4–5.6 mm long, pubescent or not. Fruit unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Branchlets glabrous. Leaves: petiole 2.5–5 mm long; blade papery, elliptic to obovate, 2.5–14.4 x 0.8–5 cm, apex acuminate to caudate, base cuneate; secondary veins 11–15 pairs; glabrous or pilose beneath. Inflorescence 8.5–17.5 cm long; glabrous or pilose; pedicels 4–8 mm long. Sepals lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, 9.7–17 x 2.8–4 mm; glabrous, without colleters inside. Corolla yellow; tube 4.9–7 cm long; lobes 1.6–3.7.cm long; glabrous outside, pubescent around stamens inside. Stamens inserted at 2.9–3.7 cm from base; anthers 4.8–5.4 x 1.5 mm. Disk 0.4 mm long. Ovary 1.5–1.9 mm long; style + pistil head 3.5–3.6 cm. Fruit 3–3.5 x 2.4–2.6 cm; with spines to 15 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Allamanda cathartica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 70. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets minutely puberulent when young. Leaves: subsessile; blade papery, elliptic to weakly obovate, 3.7–8 x 1.3–2.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 8–14 pairs; pilose beneath. Inflorescence 5–11.5 cm long; pilose; pedicels 3–6 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, 6.2–7.1 x 2–3 mm; glabrous; with colleters inside. Corolla yellow; tube 3.9–4.1 cm long; lobes 1–1.6 cm long; glabrous outside, pubescent around anthers inside. Stamens inserted at 1.2–1.4 cm from base; anthers 3.2–3.5 x 0.9–1.3 mm. Disk 0.7–0.9 mm long. Ovary 1.7–1.9 mm long; style + pistil head 11–12.7 mm. Fruit ca 2.4–3 cm diameter; with spines to 1 cm long. Seeds ca 1.2 x 0.9 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Allamanda schottii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 72. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrubs (to trees of up to 14 m high); bark smooth, brownish grey or greyish. Leaves: terminal leaflet usually longer. Leaflets deltoid to ovate to obovate, 2.5–35 by 1.5–22 cm, usually membranous; base short to long attenuate to cuneate; apex rounded to cuspidate; (sub)glabrous above, glabrous to sericeous to stiff to soft hirsute underneath. Inflorescences up to 40 cm long. Flowers white, single or in cymules along axis. Sepals ovate to obovate, 1–2.5 by 0.8–2 mm. Petals nail-shaped to spathulate, 1–2.2 mm long, the claw about ⅔ of the entire length; scales minute. Stamens: anthers ca 0.5 mm long. Fruits orange to bright red, somewhat fleshy, globular to obovoid, 4.5–12.5 by 3.5–8 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 45 m tall, to 1 m diameter at breast height; trunk often buttressed. Bark brown or grey to whitish, inner bark mottled, yellow-brown, sapwood pale yellow-white. Branchlets glabrous; branches sparsely lenticellate or not. Leaves in whorls of 4–7; petiole 1.3–3.7 cm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, 4.5–17 x 1.8–5.7 cm, oblong or obovate, apex acute to retuse, base cuneate to obtuse; secondary veins 30–57 pairs, close together, straight; glabrous; glands in the axils. Inflorescence 2.5–15 cm long; pubescent, sometimes glabrate on peduncle; many flowered, clustered; pedicels 1–2.5 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1.3–1.8 x 0.8–1.2 mm, apex acute to rounded; pubescent, ciliate. Corolla lobes overlapping to the left in bud; tube 5.6–7.5 mm long; lobes 44.6 x 1.5–2.4 mm, triangular; glabrous outside, pubescent inside except at base. Stamens inserted in upper half of corolla tube; anthers 0.9–1.2 x 0.3–0.4 mm. Disk very small and annular or absent. Ovary of 2 carpels, glabrous, 0.7–1 mm long; style + pistil head 3.1–5.6 mm. Fruit a pair of follicles; 20–30 cm long; pubescent or glabrate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alstonia angustiloba. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 42. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small compact shrub. Branchlets glabrous. Leaves in whorls of 3–4; petiole 0.4–1.9 cm long; blade papery when dry, narrowly elliptic to oblanceolate, 5–12 x 0.8–2.3 cm, apex acuminate, base decurrent or cuneate; 24–52 pairs of secondary veins, close together, ascending; glabrous; glands in the axils. Inflorescence 4.6–6 cm long; glabrous; few flowered; pedicels 7–9 mm long. Sepals ovate, 2–2.2 x 0.8–0.9 mm, apex acuminate; glabrous, not ciliate. Corolla lobes overlapping to the left in bud; tube 25–26 mm long; lobes 11–14 x 4–6 mm, elliptic, apex acute or acuminate; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and around stamens inside. Stamens inserted around middle of corolla tube; anthers 2.6 x 0.4–0.5 mm. Disk 2-lobed, between the carpels. Ovary of 2 carpels, glabrous, 1.8 mm long; style + pistil head 11.2 mm long. Fruit a pair of follicles; 9 cm long, 3–4 mm wide; glabrous; many seeded. Seeds surface glabrous and pitted; oblong, ends rounded; 5.7–9 x 1.5–2.5 mm, cilia 2.5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alstonia curtisii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 42. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 30 m, 70 cm diameter at breast height; trunk sometimes fluted at base or with small buttresses. Bark blackish-brown to grey, inner bark cream or green, sapwood white to yellowish-brown. Branchlets sparsely pubescent, glabrate; branches sparsely lenticellate or not. Leaves in whorls of 3 or 4; petiole 0.6–2.5 cm long; blade coriaceous, oblong-obovate, 5.5–28 x 3–10.2 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 14–21 pairs, widely spaced, ascending; sparsely pubescent on petiole, on underside of leaf blade and on midrib above, rarely completely glabrous. Inflorescence 3.5–11.5 cm long; sparsely pubescent or rarely glabrous; many flowered; pedicels 2–5 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1.2–2.2 x 0.8–1.2 mm, apex rounded to acute; pubescent or glabrous, ciliate. Corolla white or yellowish; lobes overlapping to the right in bud; tube 4–5.5 mm long; lobes 3.5–6.5 x 1.4–2.5 mm, oblong, apex rounded; lobes ciliate, otherwise glabrous outside, pubescent inside on base of lobes and upper part of tube. Stamens inserted in upper half of corolla tube; anthers 0.7–0.9 x 0.4 mm. Disk absent or short and annular. Ovary of 2 carpels, glabrous, 1–1.5 mm long; style + pistil head 2.5–2.7 mm long. Fruit a pair of follicles; 22–40 cm long, 2.2–3.7 mm wide; glabrous; many seeded. Seeds pubescent; oblong, one end long acuminate; 4.2–8 x 0.8–1.8 mm, cilia 5–9 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alstonia macrophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 44. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 30 m high. Branchlets glabrous. Leaves in whorls of 3–4; petiole 1.1–2.3 cm long; blade coriaceous, oblong or elliptic, 5–14 x 1.6–5.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate or decurrent; 35–56 closely parallel pairs of secondary veins; glabrous. Inflorescence 2–4.2 cm long; glabrous; many flowered; pedicels 1–2 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1.2–1.7 x 0.9–1.2 mm, apex obtuse to rounded; glabrous, ciliate. Corolla white; lobes overlapping to the left in bud; tube 4–6 mm long; lobes 2.2–2.5 x 1.4–1.8 mm, oblong, apex rounded; puberulent on top of tube and lobes outside, pubescent inside except at base of tube. Stamens inserted slightly above middle of tube; anthers 1–1.2 x 0.4 mm. Disk absent. Ovary syncarpous, glabrous, 0.6–0.9 mm long; style + pistil head 2.7–3.1 mm long. Fruit solitary; thick walled; 12–19.5 cm long, 7–8.5 mm wide; glabrous; many seeded. Seed surface glabrous; oblong, ends rounded; 10 x 2.5 mm; cilia 18 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alstonia rostrata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 44. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub to 4 m high. Branchlets glabrous; branches lenticellate. Leaves in whorls of 4–5; sessile; blade subcoriaceous, narrowly elliptic, 2.6–13 x 0.5–2.1 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 53–84 pairs, close together; glabrous; glands in the axils. Inflorescence a terminal cyme; 2–5 cm long; glabrous; many flowered; pedicels 2.5–4 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1.7 x 0.8 mm, apex obtuse; glabrous, ciliate. Corolla lobes overlapping to the left in bud; tube 7 mm; lobes 3 x 1.7 mm, oblong, apex rounded; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and beneath stamens inside. Stamens inserted at top of tube; anthers 1 mm long. Disk 2-lobed, between the carpels. Ovary of 2 carpels, glabrous, 1 mm long; style + pistil head 4 mm long. Fruit a pair of follicles; 6.1–7.5 cm long, 5 mm wide; glabrous; many seeded. Seed surface glabrous, oblong, ends rounded; 8.5 x 2.5 mm, cilia 4.5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alstonia rupestris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 45. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 40 m, to 75 cm diameter at breast height; bole often fluted. Bark brown, inner bark brown to yellow, sapwood whitish. Branchlets glabrous; branches sparsely to densely lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 7–14 mm long; in whorls of 4–8; blade coriaceous, elliptic, obovate or spathulate, 4.4–32 x 1.2–8.7 cm, apex shortly acuminate to rounded, base cuneate or decurrent; secondary veins 20–40 pairs, close together, straight; tertiary venation prominent above; glabrous. Inflorescence 3–8.5 cm long; pubescent; many flowered, clustered; pedicels ca 1 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1–1.9 x 1.5–2.3 mm, apex acute to rounded; pubescent, ciliate. Corolla white or yellowish green; lobes overlapping to the left in bud; tube 5.3–10 mm long; lobes 1.7–4.5 x 2–4.5 mm, elliptic, edges undulate; outside pubescent on top of tube and lobes, pubescent inside except at base of tube. Stamens inserted in upper half of corolla tube; anthers 1.1–2 x 0.4–0.6 mm. Disk very small and annular or absent. Ovary of 2 carpels, pubescent, 1.1–1.5 mm long; style + pistil head 2.8–5.2 mm. Fruit a pair of follicles, 21–56 cm long, 2–2.7 mm wide; glabrous; many seeded. Seeds glabrous; oblong, ends rounded; 3.9–7.5 x 1.4–1.9 mm, cilia 1.1–1.9 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alstonia scholaris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 45. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small tree to 5–10 m tall, rarely to 30 m tall; larger trees fluted or buttressed at base. Bark grey, inner bark pale yellow, sapwood white. Branches glabrous; sparsely lenticellate or not. Leaves in whorls of 3–5; blade coriaceous, spathulate, 2.5–11 x 0.8–5 cm, apex rounded or retuse, base decurrent; secondary veins 21–35 pairs, close together, straight; glabrous; glands in the axils. Inflorescence 5.8–9 cm long; lax, glabrous, many flowered; pedicels 3.5–10 mm long. Sepals ovate, 2 x 1.2–1.3 mm, apex obtuse or rounded; glabrous, ciliate. Corolla white; lobes overlapping to the left in bud; tube 6–9 mm long; lobes 6.5–9 x 3–4.5 mm, oblong, apex rounded; glabrous outside, densely pubescent inside except at base of tube. Stamens inserted in upper half of tube; anthers 1–1.1 x 0.4–0.6 mm. Disk absent or very short. Ovary of 2 carpels, glabrous, 0.9–1.2 mm long; style + pistil head 4.9–6.4 mm long. Fruit a pair of follicles; 11.8–24 cm long, 2.2–3 mm wide; glabrous; many seeded. Seeds surface glabrous; oblong, ends rounded; ca 5 x 1 mm; cilia ca 1 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alstonia spatulata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 46. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets glabrous to densely puberulent. Leaves opposite to whorls of 5; petiole 1–9 mm long; blade coriaceous or subcoriaceous, elliptic to obovate, 1.1–9.3 x 0.3–4.6 cm, apex acuminate to obtuse, base cuneate to obtuse; secondary veins 12–31 pairs; glabrous or, more rarely puberulent on midrib or all over beneath. Inflorescence 1–3.5 cm long; axillary, more rarely terminal; puberulent; pedicels 0.5–4.2 mm long. Sepals ovate to lanceolate, 1.1–1.8 x 0.4–0.9 mm, apex acuminate to obtuse; puberulent, more rarely glabrous. Corolla white, cream, yellowish and/or orangish; 5.7–11.2 mm long in mature bud of which acute to rounded head 0.18–0.42 of bud length; tube 4.8–8.5 mm long; lobes 1.2–3 mm long, ovate to oblong, apex acute to rounded; glabrous outside, pubescent in top half of tube and sometimes on tips of lobes. Stamens inserted at 2.7–8.2 mm from base; filaments 0.2–0.5 mm long; anthers 0.6–1.1 x 0.3–0.6 mm. Ovary pubescent at the base to pubescent all over, 0.4–1 mm long; style + pistil head 1.3–6 mm long. Fruit glabrous or sparsely pubescent at ends, each article 6–17 mm long, 4.8–7 mm diameter. Seeds 4.6–8.5 x 3.9–5 x 3–4.7 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alyxia reinwardtii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 55. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets glabrous or puberulent. Leaves in whorls of 3; petiole 0.2–0.9 cm long; blade coriaceous, narrowly elliptic, 1.0–9.6 x 0.4–2.7 cm, apex obtuse, acute or acuminate, base acute or cuneate, secondary veins ca 13–14 pairs, obscure or weakly visible beneath, glabrous. Inflorescence 0.7–1 cm long; axillary or terminal; densely long puberulent; pedicels 0–0.5 mm long. Sepals ovate, 2.4–2.6 x 1.1–1.2 mm, apex acute or acuminate; puberulent on centre line or puberulent on tips only. Corolla 4.9–6 mm long in mature bud of which lanceolate, acute or acuminate head 0.31–0.35 of length; tube 3.4–4.2 mm long; lobes 1.4–2.0 mm long, oblong, apex obtuse; glabrous outside, pubescent only around, or in a band below the stamens, inside. Stamens inserted at 2–2.4 mm from corolla base; filament 0.3 mm long; anthers 0.9 x 0.3–0.4 mm wide. Ovary densely pubescent all over or pubescent around base only; 0.5-0.6 mm long; style + pistil head 1.5–2.3 mm long. Fruit glabrous; articles 7.7–11.2 long, 5.8–7.7 mm diameter. Seeds 7.7–8.2 x 4.4–4.7 x 4.0 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alyxia schlechteri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 58. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets puberulent or glabrous when young; glabrous and lenticellate when older. Leaves opposite or in whorls of 3; petiole 0.5–1.2 cm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, oblong or obovate, 5.2–18.5 x 1.7–5.7 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate to obtuse; secondary veins 22–54 pairs, often prominent above; glabrous. Inflorescence 2.5–7.2 cm long, axillary and terminal forming a panicle; densely puberulent; pedicels 0.8–2.2 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1.3–1.9 x 0.7–1 mm, apex acuminate to acute; puberulent. Corolla white, sometimes also orangish; 5.6–7.7 mm long in mature bud of which narrow, acute or acuminate head 0.27–0.35 of length; tube 3.8–6 mm long; lobes 1.4–2.5 mm long, elliptic, apex obtuse or rounded; few hairs on top of tube or base of lobes outside, pubescent inside on top half of tube. Stamens inserted at 3–4.1 mm from base; filaments 0.4–0.6 mm long; anthers 1–1.1 x 0.3–0.4 mm. Ovary pubescent all over; 0.6–1 mm long; style + pistil head 2.4–4 mm long. Fruit glabrous; very succulent; each article 13–32 mm long, 10–16 mm diameter. Seeds 12.9–14 x 6.6–7.6 x 6.1–6.3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alyxia siamensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 58. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets densely tomentose and hispid, more rarely only tomentose, sometimes becoming glabrous with age; branches often with large corky tubercles. Leaves: petiole 0.8–4 cm long; blade papery, obovate, 3.7–24 x 2.4–18.2 cm, apex caudate to acuminate, base cordate, rarely to rounded; secondary veins 5–9 pairs; puberulent above and below, often glabrate above. Inflorescence 9–25.5 cm long; terminal and axillary, flowers usually clustered at end; puberulent. Sepals leafy; linear to narrowly elliptic, 4.4–10.2 x 0.9–3.8 mm, apex acute to rounded; puberulent. Corolla white or pink outside and white, red or purple inside; tube 2.3–3.1 cm long, widening slightly above stamen insertion; lobes 0.3–0.6 cm long, somewhat asymmetrical; outside puberulent, especially towards apex, rarely glabrous, inside puberulent in 5 lines below stamens. Stamens inserted at 1.2–1.4 cm from base; anthers 4.7–6.1 x 0.7–2 cm. Disk 1.4–1.7 mm long. Ovary 0.8–1.2 mm long; style + pistil head 1.5–2.2 cm long. Fruit 6.3–8.7 cm long, each follicle 1.6–1.8 cm wide. Seeds 7–10 x 5–6 mm; coma 4.3 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amalocalyx microlobus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 125. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Trees up to 25 m high; bark grey-brown, with round greyish pustules. Leaves 3–6-jugate. Leaflets ovate to falcate, 4–15 by 1.25–4 cm, parchment-like to chartaceous; base mainly acute; apex long-tapering, acuminate; glabrous on both sides. Inflorescences up to 30 cm long. Flowers white to pink, in often opposite, 5-flowered cymes. Sepals deltoid, ca 1 mm high. Petals transversely elliptic to orbicular; scale 0.5–1.2 by 1.2–1.4 mm. Stamens ca 4 mm long, anthers red. Fruits brown, with 1 or 2 lobes developed, lobes globular, 3–3.5 cm in diam., connate for ca 2.5 cm, not stipitate; wall 2–5 mm thick. Seeds shining reddish brown, 2.5–2.75 cm in diam; hilum with orbicular to kidney-shaped sarcotesta 1.5–2.5 by ca 1.5 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amesiodendron chinense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 183. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial herb. Stems arising from basal leaf rosettes, initially erect, gradually elongating to 30 cm, becoming decumbent, greyish pilose, internodes 5–14 cm, rooting at nodes. Basal leaves forming a rosette; petiole 2–3 times longer than the blade, retrorse hirtellous; blade orbicular to reniform, 1–4 cm in diameter, strigillose on both surfaces, base deeply cordate, palmately lobed to ⅓ of radius; lobes 3-lobed or crenate; stem leaves 2–3 per node, smaller than basal leaves; petiole ca as long as leaf blade. Inflorescence with 2–3 solitary flowers on nodes of stem. Bracts linear, narrowly elliptic or oblanceolate, ca 3 mm, strigillose. Pedicel slender, 1–3 cm, retrorsely hirtellous. Calyx campanulate, ca 3 mm, hirtellous, split to the middle; lobes triangular, apex acute. Corolla pink or white, ca 8 mm in diameter; tube shorter than calyx; lobes ovate oblong, ca 2.5 mm, emarginate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Androsace axillaris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 163. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches glabrous. Leaves: petiole 0.7–1.4 cm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, 4.3–12.2 x 2.4–5.4 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base obtuse; secondary veins 9–11 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence 3.5–8.5 cm long; terminal; glabrous. Sepals ovate, 1.7 x 0.7 mm, apex acute; glabrous, not ciliate. Corolla pale yellow; tube 5.3–6.8 mm long; lobes 4.5–7.3 mm long; outside glabrous; villous inside lobes, in mouth and in tube. Stamens with anthers 4 x 0.8 mm. Disk 0.5 mm long; 5-crenate. Ovary 0.9 mm long; style + pistil head 1.9 mm long. Fruit 7.3–12.5 cm long, 1.4–2.3 cm wide. Seed grain 11.8–17 x 4.3–7.1 mm; beak 2.4–7.8 mm long; coma 4–5.6 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anodendron affine. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 128. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches glabrous. Leaves: petiole 1.5–5.2 cm long; blade. thickly coriaceous, elliptic or oblong, 4.6–24 x 1.7–11.6 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded to obtuse; secondary veins 8–12 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence 3–23 cm long; mostly axillary, sometimes also terminal; glabrous. Sepals ovate, 0.6–1 x 0.3–0.6 mm, apex rounded to acute; glabrous. Corolla pinkish or cream coloured; tube 1.4–2.3 mm long; lobes 1.7–2.9 mm long; outside glabrous, pubescent inside lobes and in tube. Stamens with anthers 0.6–0.8 x 0.3–0.4 mm. Disk 0.4 mm long; 5-dentate or 5-crenate. Ovary 0.5–0.6 mm long; style + pistil head 0.7–0.8 mm long. Fruit 10.7–19.8 cm long, 0.9–1.5 cm wide. Seeds not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anodendron candolleanum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 128. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches glabrous. Leaves: petiole 8–10(–19) mm long; blade papery, elliptic, 4.2–7.2(–10) x 1–1.9(–3.9) cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 8–10 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence 3.6–5.8(–9.5) cm long; terminal, delicate; glabrous. Sepals ovate, 1.1–1.9 x 0.4–0.9 mm, apex acute; glabrous, not ciliate. Corolla greenish; tube 3.5–4.1 mm long; lobes 3.9–4.9(–6.3) mm long; outside glabrous, pubescent inside lobes and in tube. Stamens with anthers 1–1.3 x 0.3–0.4 mm. Disk 0.3–0.6 mm long; 5-crenate. Ovary 0.3–0.6 mm long; style + pistil head 0.8–1.1 mm long. Fruit 6.8–8 cm long, ca 1.2 cm wide. Seed grains 15.5–17.6 mm long, 4.5–10 mm wide; beak 2.6–11 mm long; coma 3.4–4 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anodendron coriaceum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 128. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches. glabrous. Leaves: petiole 1–1.7 cm long; blade coriaceous to subcoriaceous, elliptic, 4.6–9.5(–16.9) x 2–4(–5.2) cm, apex shortly acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 11–18(–29) pairs; glabrous, somewhat glaucous beneath. Inflorescence 10–12(–22) cm long; terminal, glabrous. Sepals ovate, 0.8–1.6 x 0.5–0.8 mm, apex acute; glabrous, not ciliate. Corolla tube 1.9–4 mm long; lobes 3–8.5 mm long; outside glabrous, villous inside lobes, in mouth and in tube. Stamens with anthers 1.2–1.6 x 0.4–0.5 mm. Disk 0.4–0.6 mm long; 5-crenate. Ovary 0.4–0.6 mm long; style + pistil head 0.6–1.2 mm long. Fruit 8.3–11.5 cm long, 1–1.2 cm wide. Seed grains 16–20 mm long, 4.5–6 mm wide; beak 7–22 mm long; coma 3.5–4.5 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anodendron nervosum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 129. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches glabrous. Leaves: petiole 1.3–2.6 cm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, oblong or obovate, 5.2–19.2 x 1.6–8.4 cm, apex shortly acuminate, often abruptly so, base obtuse to rounded; secondary veins 8–16 pairs, usually wrinkled in dry plant; glabrous. Inflorescence 5.5–15.2 cm long; axillary and terminal, often. forming a terminal panicle; glabrous. Sepals ovate, 0.7–1.3 x 0.4–0.9 mm, apex rounded to acute; glabrous, ciliate or not ciliate. Corolla white or yellowish; tube 1.2–2.2 mm long; lobes 1.7–3.4 mm long; outside glabrous, villous inside lobes, mouth and top of tube. Stamens with anthers 0.7–1.1 x 0.2–0.3 mm. Disk 0.3–0.4 mm; annular or weakly 5 crenate. Ovary 0.3–0.6 mm long; style + pistil head 0.4–0.7 mm long. Fruit 9.5–15.5 cm long, 1.7–2.5 cm wide. Seed grains 1.3–2.2 cm long, 0.6–0.8 mm wide; beak 6–15 mm long; coma 5.2–8.5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anodendron paniculatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 129. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches minutely puberulent. Leaves: petiole 1–1.8 cm; blade coriaceous, oblong to elliptic, 4.8–14.4 x 1.6–4.7 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base obtuse to acute; secondary veins 7–13 pairs, wrinkled or not when dry; glabrous, covered in small brown punctae. Inflorescence 2.2–6 cm long; mostly axillary; puberulent. Sepals ovate, 1–1.7 x 0.7–1 mm, apex acute; minutely puberulent at base, ciliate. Corolla yellowish; tube 2.2–3 mm long; lobes 2.9–4 mm long; outside glabrous, villous inside lobes, in mouth and in top of tube. Stamens with anthers 0.9–1.1 x 0.4 mm. Disk 0.4–0.6 mm long; annular. Ovary 0.4–0.7 mm long; style + pistil head 0.9–1 mm long. Fruit 7.5–13.6 cm long, 8.5–12.5 mm wide. Seed grains 1.2–1.6 cm long, 0.3–0.6 cm wide; beak 3.5–5.8 mm long; coma 2–5.8 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anodendron punctatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 131. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Trees up to 20 m high; bark grey to whitish grey, lenticellate. Leaves (1–)2–4 jugate. Leaflets ovate, 2–7 by 2–4 cm, chartaceous; base shortly attenuate; apex emarginate to acuminate; usually subpilose close to base of midrib on both sides, seldom villous underneath. Inflorescences up to 15 cm long, with long cincinnate cymules. Flowers reddish green (sepals), pleasantly scented, 1.5–1.8 cm in diam. Sepals ovate to elliptic, 5.5–9 by 1.7–4.5 mm. Petals obovate, 3–3.3 by 0.7–1.2 mm, white. Stamens: filaments 6.3–9.1 mm long, green; anthers 1–1.2 by 0.5–0.8 mm, orange. Fruits 3.2–5.5 by 3–4.3 cm, stipitate; wings up to 2 cm wide. Seeds black with brown hairs, 5–5.5 by 5.5–6.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Arfeuillea arborescens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 185. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: (Shrubs to) trees up to 20 m high; bark smooth, greyish green to almost black. Leaves mainly 2 - or 3-jugate. Leaflets ovate to elliptic, 4–31 by 1.5–12 cm, chartaceous, base acute to slightly attenuate; apex acuminate to cuspidate; glabrous on both sides (Thailand); domatia present as many sacs. Inflorescences 1.5–17 cm long. Flowers 1–3.5 mm in diam., cream to yellowish, fragrant. Calyx deeply incised, lobes up to 2 mm long. Petals triangular to rhomboidal to (ob)ovate, 0.5–2.2 mm long, claw 0.1–0.4 mm long; scales 0.2–1.2 mm long, apex broadened. Disc glabrous to pilose. Stamens 6–8(–10); filaments 2–4 mm long, anthers 0.7–1.1 mm long. Fruits 0.7–3.6 by 0.5–2.3 cm, smooth, orange to red; stipe ca 3 mm long, slender (Thailand); lobes 8–23 by 5–21 mm. Seeds blackish brown, 6–24 by 5–19 mm; arillode red.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Arytera litoralis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 187. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Leaves: petiole 1–3 cm long; blade elliptic to obovate, 8–29 x 3–11 cm, apex acuminate to caudate, base cuneate; tomentose when young becoming almost glabrous. Inflorescence lax; 15–25 cm long; peduncle 3–4(–6.5) cm long; 3–19-flowered. Sepals leafy; ovate, (3–)4.5–5.3 x 1.5–5 cm, apex acuminate; sparsely tomentose. Corolla white; tube 8.2–12 cm long; lobes (1.8–)4–5.5 cm long, apex acuminate; tomentose outside and inside on lobes, glabrous lower down. Stamens inserted at 2.5–4 cm from corolla base; filaments (3.3–)4.5–6 cm long, glabrous; anthers 13–16 x 2–3.4 mm. Disk pubescent at top. Ovary 2–3 mm, pubescent; style + pistil head 8.2–10 cm long, sparsely pubescent. Fruit 22–31 cm long, 5–6 cm wide; ellipsoid, obtuse at the apex. Seeds 15–25 x 4–7 mm; obtuse at both ends; coma 2–7 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Beaumontia grandiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 101. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Leaves: petiole 2.5–3.5 cm long; blade elliptic, 14–25 x 12–15 cm, apex apiculate, base cuneate to almost rounded; tomentose. Inflorescence congested; 7–9 cm; peduncle 1.5 cm; 17–34-flowered. Sepals oblong-elliptic, 9 x 2.5 mm, apex acute; tomentose. Corolla greenish yellow; tube 1.7–2.4 cm long; lobes 0.8–1.2 cm, apex acute to apiculate; tomentose outside, sparsely tomentose on lobes and top of tube inside and again below the anther insertion with a glabrous band in the middle; with 10 small corona-like appendages alternating with the corolla lobes. Stamens inserted at 8 mm above the base; filaments 8.5 mm long, pubescent at base; anthers 7.8 x 1.5 mm. Disk pubescent at the apex. Ovary pubescent, 2.5 mm long; style + pistil head 1.7 cm long, sparsely pubescent. Fruit unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Beaumontia macrantha. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 101. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Leaves: petiole 1–2 cm long; blade papery, elliptic to obovate, 5.5–22.5 x 2–8.5(–13) cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; older leaves sparsely pubescent on abaxial veins. Inflorescence lax; 10–17 cm long; peduncle 1.5–10 cm long; 8–38-flowered. Sepals leafy; elliptic, (0.9–)1.8–1.9 x 0.2–0.6 cm, apex acuminate; tomentose. Corolla white and pale yellow or green; tube 3–4.6 cm long; lobes 1.7–3 cm long, apex acuminate; tomentose outside and on lobes inside, inside tube glabrous. Stamens inserted at 1–1.3 cm from corolla base; filaments 1.5–2.7 cm long, glabrous; anthers 10–13 x 1.9–3 mm. Disk glabrous or very sparsely pubescent. Ovary densely pubescent, 0.5–1.5 mm long; style + pistil head 3.2–3.7 cm long, very sparsely pubescent. Fruit a solitary follicle; oblong/ellipsoid, apex rounded, base cordate; 10–26 cm long, 3–7 cm wide; seeds numerous. Seeds ellipsoid; flattened; 15–20 x 3.5–4 mm; coma 2–5 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Beaumontia multiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 103. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Leaves: petiole 1–2.5 cm long; blade papery, elliptic or obovate, 9–29 x 4.5–14.2 cm, apex acuminate or apiculate, base obtuse to cuneate; tomentose when young becoming almost glabrous. Inflorescence lax; 11–16(–19.5) cm long; peduncle 2–3.3(–6) cm long; 3–15 flowered. Sepals leafy; ovate, 2.4–4 x 1.1–2.3 cm, apex acuminate or apiculate. Corolla white or yellowish; tube 4.2–6 cm long; lobes 1.8–5.6 cm long, apex acute or acuminate; tomentose outside and on lobes and upper corolla tube inside, otherwise glabrous. Stamens inserted at 1.8–2.2 cm from corolla base; filaments (1.5–)2.4–3.5 cm long, glabrous; anthers 10.7–14.2 x 2–2.4 mm, sagittate base 2–3.5 mm long. Disk glabrous or very sparsely pubescent. Ovary densely pubescent, 1.4–2.5 mm long; style + pistil head 3.6 cm long, glabrous or sparsely pubescent. Fruit 18 cm long, 5 cm wide; ellipsoid, obtuse at the apex, cordate at the base; glabrous. Seeds 11–20 x 4–5 mm; sparsely pubescent or glabrous; obtuse at both ends; coma 3–8 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Beaumontia murtonii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 103. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branchlets sparsely puberulent or glabrous; branches with small lenticels. Leaves: petiole 0.8–2.5 cm long; blade coriaceous, oblong to narrowly elliptic, 5.5–13.1 x 1.3–3.7 cm, apex caudate, base acute to cuneate; secondary veins 17–24 pairs, straight, anastomosing into an intramarginal nerve; glabrous, punctate beneath. Inflorescence 2.4–6 cm long; flowers lax; glabrous or very sparsely puberulent; pedicels 3.5–9 mm long. Sepals ovate, 2.3–2.8 x 1.3–2.1 mm, apex rounded; glabrous. Corolla white; tube 5.1–6.7 mm long; lobes 2.9–3.1 mm long; glabrous outside and inside. Stamens inserted at 2.2–4 mm from corolla base; filaments 0.3–0.7 mm long; anthers 2.9–3 x 0.8–0.9 mm. Disk 0.7–0.9 mm long. Ovary 2 mm long; style + pistil head 1.8 mm long. Fruits ovoid; 2–3 x 1.5–3 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bousigonia angustifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 22. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, often much branched, stems deeply 5-sulcate. Leaves 5–8 by 5–8 cm, sparsely appressed (sub)pilose. Leaflets ovate, symmetrical, herbaceous; base attenuate; apex and lobes acute, mucronulate; glabrous above, subpilose underneath; domatia absent. Inflorescences 5–14 cm long. Flowers 2–3.5 mm long, white. Sepals outer broadly ovate to suborbicular, 1–1.5 by ca 1.2 mm, inner suborbicular to broad-elliptic, 2–2.5 by 1.5–2 mm. Petals obovate-cuneate to orbicular, 1.5–2.5 by 1–2 mm; scales 1.2–2 by ca 1 mm, bearded; crest glabrous. Disc lobes glabrous. Stamens: filaments 0.8–2.5 mm long; anthers ca 0.5 mm long, yellow. Fruits 1.5–4 cm in diam., mostly sparsely short-hairy, green to tinged reddish; shortly stipitate. Seeds subglobular, ca 4 mm in diam., dull-black, smooth, glabrous; hilum white.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cardiospermum halicacabum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 189. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, shrub or small tree to 5 m. Branchlets glabrous. Leaves: petiole ca 1–3 mm long; blade coriaceous, broadly ovate or oblong, 3–7 x 1.5–4 cm, apex rounded or retuse, base obtuse; 4–12 pairs of secondary veins, ascending; glabrous. Inflorescence ca 3.5–5.5 cm long. Sepals ovate, 1.8–3.5 x 1–2 mm, acute; sparsely puberulent or glabrous, ciliate. Corolla white or pale pink; tube 16–21.5 mm long; lobes 7–10 mm long; pubescent outside and inside on tube and lobes. Stamens inserted at 10.5–14 mm from base; filaments 0.3–0.5 mm long; anthers 2–3 x 0.6–0.8 mm. Ovary 1.5–23 mm long, glabrous; style + pistil head ca 1 cm long. Fruit red or black, 15–23 x 12–17 x 12–17 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carissa carandas. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 11. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, shrub or small tree to 5 m tall. Branchlets glabrous or sparsely puberulent, becoming glabrous. Leaves: petiole 1.5–4.5 mm long; blade coriaceous, ovate to obovate or orbicular, 1.4–5.5 x 0.8–4.7 cm, apex weakly retuse to acuminate, apiculate or mucronate, base cuneate to rounded; 2–5 pairs of secondary veins, strongly ascending; glabrous to pubescent on both sides. Inflorescence 1.4–4 cm long; terminal and/or axillary; glabrous or sparsely puberulent. Sepals ovate to narrowly ovate, 1.5–3 x 0.4–1.5 mm, apex acute to acuminate; glabrous, rarely sparsely puberulent, ciliate. Corolla white; tube 5–21.5 mm long; lobes 1.5–15 mm long, ovate or oblong, apex acuminate to acute; glabrous outside, lobes ciliate and glabrous or pubescent inside, tube pubescent inside. Stamens inserted at 3.3–16 mm from base; filaments 0.2–0.5 mm long; anthers 1–2.5 x 0.3–0.7 mm. Ovary 0.5–1.5 mm long, glabrous or weakly papillose; style + pistil head 3–11.4 mm long. Fruit ovoid or subglobose; 3–60 mm long, 3–60 mm diameter; glabrous.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carissa spinarum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 11. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems puberulent. Leaves: petiole 2–8 mm long; blade papery, elliptic or slightly obovate, 1.5–6 x 0.6–2.6 cm, apex obtuse or rounded and apiculate, base obtuse to cuneate; 7–10 pairs of strongly ascending secondary veins; sparsely puberulent. Inflorescence of 1 or 2 flowers; terminal but appearing axillary; puberulent. Sepals lanceolate, 1.5–5 x 0.5–0.7 mm; puberulent. Corolla white or pink with a purple, pink or yellow eye; tube 2.3–2.9 cm long; lobes 1.3–1.9 cm long; puberulent on tube outside, around mouth and inside at top of tube. Stamens situated at top of corolla tube; filaments 0.4 mm long; anthers 2.6–2.8 x 0.6–0.8 mm. Disk lobes lanceolate; 2.3–2.6 mm long. Ovary 1.9–3 mm long, puberulent; style + pistil head 1.9–2.1 cm long. Fruits narrowly oblong, longitudinally grooved, apex acute; sparsely puberulent; 1.5–2.5 cm long, 1.5–3.2 mm wide. Seeds 1.6–2.1 x 0.7–1.2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Catharanthus roseus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 48. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree or shrub to 9 m tall. Branchlets glabrous. Leaves: petiole 0.9–4 cm long; blade papery to coriaceous, elliptic to obovate, 5.5–24 x 2–6.3 cm, apex abruptly acuminate, apiculate or, rarely, rounded, base cuneate; secondary veins 13–24 pairs anastomosing into an intramarginal nerve; glabrous. Inflorescence few to many flowered, lax, robust; 6.8–31 cm long; glabrous; pedicels 6.5–22 mm long. Sepals linear, lanceolate or oblanceolate, 9:5–17 x 2.9–5 mm; glabrous. Corolla white with a red eye (in Thailand); tube 2.6–4.3 cm long, narrow, widening near the throat; lobes 1.5–2.9 cm long; glabrous outside, pubescent most of length of tube inside. Stamens inserted just beneath mouth; anthers 1.3–1.7 x 1.1–1.8 mm. Ovary 1.4–1.8 mm long; style + pistil head 2.1–4 cm long. Fruit oblong or ellipsoid; reddish when mature; 6.5–10 cm long, 4.9 cm diameter.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cerbera manghas. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 1, 1999. Pg. 67. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree or shrub to 12 m tall. Leaves: petiole 1.6–3.8 cm long; blade papery to coriaceous, obovate, 8.9–26 x 2.4–5.7 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 12–25 pairs anastomosing into an intramarginal nerve; glabrous. Inflorescence few to many flowered, robust, lax; 8.8–35 cm long; glabrous; pedicels 1.2–4 cm long. Sepals linear, lanceolate or oblanceolate, 8.6–26 x 2.6–5 mm, apex acute or acuminate; glabrous. Corolla white with a yellow eye (in Thailand); tube 1.3–2.2 cm long, bulging in middle; lobes 1.2–3.8 cm long; glabrous outside, pubescent in upper half of tube inside. description: Branchlets glabrous. description: Branchlets glabrous or puberulent. description: Branchlets terete, tomentose; branches glabrous and lenticellate. description: Branchlets strongly angled or flattened when dry, tomentose to glabrate; branches lenticellate. description: Shrubs or trees up to 15 m high; bark dark to greyish brown. Leaves (2–)3- or 4- jugate. description: Shrubs to small trees up to 8 m high; bark reddish brown, smooth with fine ridges. Indumentum absent, glands present. description: Tree to 66 m with a cylindrical bole to 3 m diameter. Bark dark grey or black, smooth with squarish scales. Branchlets glabrous. description: Branchlets puberulent or tomentose, usually with longer villous hairs; branches often glabrous and sparsely lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 0.9–1.6 cm long; blade papery to coriaceous, broadly elliptic to obovate, 7.1–15.5 x 4–10.9 cm, apex sharp acuminate, base cordate or, rarely, rounded; secondary veins 7–10 pairs; villous to glabrate beneath and above, particularly on midrib and veins. description: Branchlets tomentose; branches glabrous and lenticellate. description: Trees up to 10 m high; outer bark usually smooth, whitish to dark grey. Leaves 1–4-jugate; rachis winged or not. description: Shrub to 2.5 m. Branchlets densely to sparsely pubescent. Leaves: petiole 1–4 mm; blade subcoriaceous when dry, obovate or elliptic, 3–12.6 x 1–7.3 cm, apex rounded, apiculate or retuse, less often acute or acuminate especially in Peninsular Thailand, base cuneate, less often rounded or obtuse, first leaves on branch generally much smaller and strongly emarginate; pubescent on both surfaces, rarely almost glabrous. description: Shrub or tree to 15 m. Branchlets pubescent or occasionally glabrous. description: Tree to 20 m tall. Branchlets glabrous. Corolla white; tube 6.1–8.6 mm long; lobes 2.1–5.1 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent at top of tube inside. Stamens inserted at 5.4–6.8 mm from corolla base; filaments 0.3–0.8 mm long; anthers 0.7–1 x 0.4–0.5 mm. Ovary 0.8–1.2 mm long; style + pistil head 5.3–6.2 mm long. Fruits 1.5–3.4 cm long, 0.8–1.6 cm diameter; orange when mature. Seeds 10.8–15.2 x 6.8–9.8 mm.

description: Branchlets pubescent or shortly tomentose, often becoming glabrous and lenticellate when older. Leaves: petiole 3.5–14(–29) mm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, elliptic or ovate, 2.3–12.5 x 0.7–7 cm, 1.3–4.4 x as long as wide, apex acuminate or more rarely acute or obtuse, base cuneate to rounded; secondary veins 4–8 pairs; commonly pubescent on midrib beneath, more rarely glabrous or tomentose all over beneath; glands present or absent in leaf axils and on interpetiolar ridge. Inflorescence 1.5–13(–17) cm long; axillary and terminal; usually shortly tomentose, sometimes becoming glabrous. Sepals ovate or triangular, 0.8–1.8(–2.4) x 0.5–1.1 mm, apex acute, rarely acuminate or obtuse; sparsely to densely pubescent or shortly tomentose. Corolla white or yellowish; tube 1.8–3.2(–4) mm long; lobes longer than the tube, 2.6–6 mm long, upper part consisting of a strap-shaped projection to the right; outside glabrous, pubescent only on tube or pubescent on tube and the part of the lobes exposed in bud, lobes usually ciliate, mouth densely villous, upper part of tube inside glabrous or sparsely pubescent. Stamens inserted at 0.9–1.4 mm from base; anthers 0.9–1.1 x 0.3–0.5 mm. Disk 0.4–1 mm long, lobes narrow and free, slightly bulging on top. Ovary 0.3–0.7 mm long, pubescent; style + pistil head 1.1–2 mm long. Fruit 3–10.5(–17.1) cm long, 1.6–5 mm wide; tomentose, often becoming glabrous. Seeds 1.9–2.4 cm long, 0.8–1 mm wide; coma 1.8–3 cm long.

description: Branchlets densely long tomentose. Leaves: petiole 2.5–9 mm long; blade papery, oblong, 3.5–10.6 x 1.6–4.3 cm, 2.2–3.6 x as long as wide, elliptic or ovate, apex acuminate, base rounded or weakly cordate; secondary veins 5–10 pairs; tomentose above and below, often becoming glabrous above. Inflorescence 1–3 cm long; axillary and terminal; tomentose. Sepals ovate, 1.7–3 x 1–1.8 mm, apex obtuse or rounded, rarely acute; tomentose. Corolla white or yellow; tube 2.6–3.5 mm long; lobes shorter than the tube, 1.8–2.8 mm long; outside glabrous, pubescent on tube or pubescent on tube and part of lobes exposed in bud, mouth glabrous, inside glabrous or sparsely pubescent in upper part of tube. Stamens inserted on corolla tube at 1.2–1.6 mm from base; filaments 0.2–0.4 mm; anthers 1.5–1.8 x 0.7–0.8 mm. Disk 0.7–0.9 mm, lobes narrow and free, not bulging on top. Ovary 0.5–0.7 mm, pubescent; style + pistil head 2.2–2.6 mm. Fruit 5.7–19 cm long, 3.6 mm wide; glabrous, lenticellate. Seeds 18 x 3 mm; coma 2–3 cm long.

description: Branchlets puberulent when young; branches usually glabrous. Leaves: petiole 0.5–1.4(–2.1) mm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, (1.7–)3.9–17 x 1.4–4.8(–6.1) cm, 1.6–4.2 x as long as wide, apex short to long sharp acuminate, base cuneate or, rarely, to rounded; secondary veins 8–20 pairs; glabrous or sparsely puberulent beneath. Inflorescence 1–8.5(–16.5) cm long; axillary and terminal; puberulent. Sepals ovate, 1.3–2.6 x 0.8–1.4 mm, apex obtuse to rounded; puberulent. Corolla white or yellow; tube 2.3–4 mm long; lobes as long as or longer than the tube, 2.7–4.5(–7.2) mm long; outside glabrous or, rarely, sparsely puberulent, pubescent in mouth and inside. Stamens inserted on corolla tube at 1–1.9 mm from base; filaments 0.1–0.2 mm long; anthers 1.5–2.5 x 0.3–0.5 mm. Disk 0.2–0.4 mm, entire, 5-dentate. Ovary 0.8–1.3 mm, pubescent; style + pistil head 1.1–2.1 mm long. Fruit villous to glabrous; 10–25.5 cm long, 2.3–7 mm wide. Seeds 19–25 x 2.1–5 mm; coma 23–32 mm long.

description: Branchlets puberulent; branches glabrous. Leaves: petiole 6–16 mm long; blade subcoriaceous to coriaceous, broadly elliptic, (0.6–)4.5–7.7(–11.5) x (0.3–)2.4–4.9(–5.6) cm, 1.1–3.3 x as long as wide, apex bluntly acuminate to rounded, base obtuse to rounded; secondary veins 6–9(–16) pairs; very sparesly puberulent beneath or glabrous. Inflorescence 1.2–5.6 cm long, axillary and terminal; tomentose. Sepals ovate, 1.3–1.5 x 0.9–1.1 mm, apex rounded to obtuse; tomentose. Corolla white or yellow; tube 2.5–5 mm long; lobes shorter than tube, 1–2.1 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and in tube. Fruit 1.8–7.2 cm long, 2.5–5.6 mm wide. Seeds 1.2–2.8 x 1.3–2.3 mm; coma 1.8–4.6 cm long.

description: Branchlets pubescent. Leaves: petiole 1.2–2.3 mm long; blade papery, linear oblong, 1.7–8.5 x 0.3–1.3 cm, 4.8–6.7 x as long as wide, apex acute, base cuneate; secondary veins 4–6 pairs; glabrous or sparsely pubescent at base beneath; glands in the axils. Inflorescence 0.7–1.5 cm long; axillary; tomentose. Sepals ovate, 0.9–1 x 0.7 mm, apex acute or acuminate; sparsely pubescent on tips. Corolla white; tube 1.8–2.7 mm; lobes 3–5.5 mm long, upper part a strap-shaped projection to the right; outside glabrous, mouth glabrous or sparsely pubescent, inside glabrous. Stamens inserted at 1–1.1 mm from base; filaments 0.2–0.3 mm long; anthers 0.9–1.2 x 0.4–0.5 mm. Disk 0.5–0.6 mm long, lobes narrow and free, not bulging on top. Ovary 0.4–0.5 mm long, pubescent; style + pistil head 1.5–1.7 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Tree to 45 m, sometimes with short buttresses, trunk straight. Branches transversely fissured; lenticellate; glabrous or locally pubescent. Leaves: petiole 5–14 mm long; blade coriaceous to papery, elliptic, 10.5–26 x 4.6–13 cm, apex acuminate to obtuse, base cuneate or rounded; sparsely pubescent on underside. Inflorescence 5.5–6.5 cm long; 1–12 flowered. Sepals ovate, 6.5 x 3.2–3.5 mm, apex acute or acuminate; mostly glabrous, rarely minutely pubescent; ciliate. Corolla white; tube 1.7–2.7 cm long widening at 0.9–1.3 cm; lobes 2.2–3 cm long, elliptic; tube glabrous outside and inside, lobes pubescent outside and inside. Stamens inserted where tube widens; anthers 6.5 x 1.5 mm. Ovary glabrous, 3.7–4 mm long; style + pistil head glabrous, 1.4 cm long. Fruit 25–85 x 1–2.5 cm; follicles parallel or divergent. Seed grains 2.8–3.5 x 0.2–0.3 cm; beak 8–10 cm long; hairs 2–10 cm long.

description: Shrub or tree to 20 m. Branches transversely fissured or not; sparsely lenticellate; glabrous. Leaves: petiole 2–6 mm long; blade coriaceous to papery, elliptic, 8.5–16 x 2–4 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; glabrous. Inflorescence 1.8–2.4 cm long; 2–7-flowered. Sepals ovate, 1.9–2.3 x 1.1–1.4 mm, apex obtuse; ciliate, otherwise glabrous. Corolla white or pale yellow; tube 0.9–1.3 cm; lobes 0.8–1.2 cm long, elliptic; tube glabrous inside and outside; lobes puberulent on both surfaces. Stamens inserted near top of tube; anthers 2.5 x 0.8 mm. Ovary pubescent, 1.7 mm long; style + pistil head 8 mm long. Fruit 11.7–18.5 cm long, 5–8 mm wide, somewhat flattened; lenticellate or not, many seeded. Seed grains 2.1 x 0.2 cm; beak 2.9 cm long; hairs 4.9 cm long.

description: Trees or shrubs to 15 m. Branches minutely puberulent or glabrous; often fissured. Leaves: petiole 5–17 mm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, 17–35 x 5–13 cm, apex acuminate or shortly caudate, base cuneate; pubescent below or only on midrib or secondary veins, rarely glabrous. Inflorescence 2.8–4.2 cm long; 4–12 flowered. Sepals ovate, 3.5–4x 1.6–2.4 mm, apex acute; pubescent, ciliate. Corolla white or light green; tube 1.1 cm long; lobes 1.2–1.5 cm long, oblanceolate or elliptic; tube glabrous outside, lobes and upper part of tube inside pubescent. Stamens inserted near top of tube; anthers 2.9–3.1 x 0.7–0.8 mm. Ovary pubescent, 1.7–1.9 mm; style + pistil head glabrous, 8.3 mm. Fruit green; not lenticellate; 7.5–18.5 cm long, 5–10 mm wide and somewhat flattened; many seeded. Seed grains 11.5–18 x 2–2.4 mm; beak 2.7–3 cm long; hairs 2.8–3.2 cm long.

description: Tree to 25 m. Branches transversely fissured; sparsely lenticellate; glabrous. Leaves: petiole 4–7 mm long; blade coriaceous to papery, elliptic, 5.4–12 x 1–4.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; glabrous. Inflorescence 3 cm long; 4–25 flowered. Sepals ovate, 1.7–2.1 x 1–1.2 mm, apex acute; ciliate, otherwise glabrous. Corolla white; tube 7–9 mm long; lobes 11–13 mm long, oblong; tube glabrous outside, pubescent inside; lobes pubescent on both surfaces. Stamens inserted at the top of the corolla tube; anthers 2.3–2.4 x 0.5–0.6 mm. Ovary pubescent, 1.4 mm long; style + pistil head glabrous, 3.5–7.3 mm. Fruit 8–50 x 0.4–0.6 cm. description: Tree to 5 m. Branchlets puberulent becoming glabrous. Leaves: petiole 3–4 mm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic to oblong, 4.3–11.1 x 1.4–3.3 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 12–14 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence terminal and axillary; flowers clustered; densely pubescent; 2.5–8.5 cm long; pedicels 0.6–1.5 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, 2.9–3.6 x 0.9–1 mm, apex acute; pubescent. Corolla white; tube 13.7–15.5 mm long; lobes 7.6–8.2 mm long, lanceolate; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and just beneath stamens inside. Stamens inserted at 11–13 mm from corolla base; filaments 0.6 mm long; anthers 1.3 x 0.5 mm. Disk 1 mm long. Ovary 0.8 mm long, pubescent on top; style + pistil head ca 10 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Shrub or tree to 12 m. Branchlets minutely puberulent or glabrous. Leaves: petiole 4–8 mm long; blade coriaceous or subcoriaceous, elliptic, 7–21.8 x 1.6–6 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate to acute; secondary veins 15–18 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence a lax cyme; glabrous or puberulent; 6.5–9 cm long; pedicels 1.5–2.5 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, 2.4–2.7 x 1.3–1.6 mm, apex acuminate or acute; glabrous or puberulent. Corolla white; tube 28–35 mm long; lobes 14–19 mm long, lanceolate; glabrous outside or with ciliate lobes, pubescent in mouth and beneath stamens inside. Stamens inserted at 25–32 mm from corolla base; filaments 1.1 mm long; anthers 1.7 x 0.5 mm. Disk 1.6–2.1 mm long. Ovary 0.9–1.1 mm long, pubescent or glabrous; style + pistil head 2.5–2.6 cm long. Fruit ovoid; 2.6–3.9 cm long, 1.1–2.2 cm wide.

description: Shrub or small tree to 10 m. Branchlets glabrous. Leaves: petiole 3–10 mm long; blade coriaceous, broadly lanceolate to elliptic, 5–24.5 x 2.3–9.7 cm, apex acuminate to caudate, base acute to cuneate; secondary veins 9–19 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence cincinnate and robust; densely puberulent; 6–7.5 cm long; flowers subsessile. Sepals ovate, 2.6–3 x 2–2.2 mm, apex rounded; glabrous or sparsely puberulent. Corolla white or pale pink; tube 19–33 mm long; lobes 23–27 mm long, obovate, rounded; glabrous or with few hairs outside, glabrous or puberulent in mouth, puberulent beneath stamens inside. Stamens inserted at 16–28 mm from corolla base; filaments 0.6–0.7 mm long; anthers 2.1–2.5 mm. Disk 1.1–2.2 mm long. Ovary 1.5–2.5 mm long, glabrous or sparsely puberulent; style + pistil head 1.6–2.6 cm long. Fruit with a large beaked appendage, ca 1.9 cm long. Seeds ca 10 x 5.7 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree to 6 m. Branchlets glabrous or puberulent. Leaves: petiole 2–12.5 mm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, 4.7–19 x 1.5–8.3 cm, apex acuminate to caudate, base cuneate; secondary veins 7–17 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence cincinnate or branched cincinnate; glabrous; 4.5–10 cm long; pedicels 1.6–6.5 mm long. Sepals ovate, 2.2–2.9 x 1.6–2.1 mm, apex rounded; glabrous, ciliate. Corolla white or pink; tube 26–45 mm long; lobes 16–31 mm long, obovate, rounded; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and beneath stamens inside. Stamens inserted at 22–35 mm from corolla base; filaments 0.6–0.9 mm long; anthers 2.2–2.4 x 0.6-0.8 mm. Disk 0.5–1.8 mm long. Ovary 0.5–1.5 mm long, glabrous or pubescent; style + pistil head 2.2–3.6 cm long.

description: Trees up to 20 m high. Leaves paripinnate, 1- or 2–(3-)jugate. Leaflets ovate to elliptic, 9.5–20 by 3.7–8.2 cm, chartaceous; base obtuse to acute; apex obtuse to acuminate, slightly tapering; glabrous on both sides. Inflorescences up to 45 cm long, golden velvety when dry. Flowers white, scented. Sepals 5, outer two ovate, inner three broadly obovate, 2.8–3.5 by 2–2.5 mm. Petals 5, hardly clawed, blade obovate, 1.5–3 by 1–2 mm; scale single, broad, apically lobed, ciliate, not crested. Stamens: filaments ca 3.5 mm long; anthers ca 1 mm long. Ovary 3-locular. Fruits lobed, ca 2.5 cm in diam., strongly wrinkled when dry, lobed, densely ferrugineous (orange to brown when fresh) velvety. Seeds usually 1 or 2, slightly flattened ellipsoid, ca 18 by 12 by 10 mm; hilum ca 5 by 2.mm.

description: Shrubs or trees up to 10(–15) m high, bark variably brown to silvery grey, smooth or lenticellate. Leaves imparipinnate with the terminal leaflet often very reduced; pseudo-stipules present. Leaflets ovate to obovate, 9–40 by 2–12 cm, thin-chartaceous to coriaceous; base subcordate to acute, mostly attenuate; apex obtuse to acuminate; (sub)glabrous on both sides. Inflorescences up to 75 cm long. Flowers (white to) reddish purple (incl. sepals), scentless. Sepals 4 (Thailand), orbicular to elliptic to obovate, 2–4 by 1.5–3 mm. Petals 4 (Thailand), short-clawed, blade ovate to obovate, 1.5–3 by 1–2 mm; scale 2 or single, small, ciliate. Stamens 5–8; anthers subsessile, 1.2–2.2 mm long. Ovary 2-locular (Thailand). Fruits dark red to bluish black; ovoid to ellipsoid, 1–3 by 0.6–2 by 0.5–2 cm (fresh up to 4 cm in diam.), not lobed, glabrous outside and within. Seeds usually 2, brownish black, with flat axial side, 8–23 by 6–18 by 4–18 mm; hilum up to 6 by 4 mm.

description: Shrubs to small trees up to 16 m high; bark brown to grey, rather smooth. Leaves paripinnate, (2–)3–6(–9)-jugate. Leaflets ovate (mainly lower ones) to obovate (upper ones), 3–31 by 1.5–11 cm, stiff chartaceous; base rounded to broadly cuneate; apex obtuse to acuminate; subpilose to densely pilose on both sides. Inflorescences up to 50 cm long. Flowers white to yellow, sweetly fragrant. Sepals orbicular to ovate, 1.2–2.8 by 1.2–3 mm. Petals 4 (or 5), claw 0.5–1 mm long, blade obovate, 2–4 by 1.5–2.2 mm; scale single with two apical clavate crests, 1.5–3 mm long, (glabrous to) pilose and apically densely bearded. Disc a high rim, especially in staminate flowers. Stamens: filaments (1.5–)3–5 mm long; anthers ca 0.8 mm long. Ovary: 3-locular. Fruits dark purple to nearly black, ± sessile, lobed, lobes 8–13 by 7–8 mm, glabrous outside and within. Seeds shiny brown to black, 9–11 by 4 by 4 mm; hilum small.

description: Shrubs or small trees up to 24 m high; bark greyish to brown or black, smooth to verruculose. Leaves paripinnate, up to 6-jugate, but mainly unifoliolate or unijugate (Thailand). Leaflets elliptic, 7–35(–60 when simple) by 2–18 cm, chartaceous to subcoriaceous; base emarginate (simple leaves) to obtuse, acute, attenuate; apex obtuse to acuminate; glabrous on both sides. Inflorescences up to 40(–60) cm long. Flowers slightly fragrant, in 3-flowered cymules. Sepals 5, dark red, ovate to orbicular, 1–4 by 0.8–3 mm. Petals 5, cream to greenish white, elliptic to obovate, 2.5–4.5 by 1–2 mm; scales minute. Stamens 5–7(–9); filaments white, 1–3.5 mm long; anthers light yellow to purplish, 1–1.8 mm long. Ovary 2-locular (Thailand). Fruits dark purplish red to black, sessile or short-stipitate, stipe up to 2 mm long; lobed, lobes 8–15 by 5–15 mm, glabrous outside and within. Seeds shiny brown to black, 7–8 by 6–7 mm; hilum small.

description: Shrubs or small trees (to trees up to 22.5 m high); bark (greyish) brown, usually smooth to lenticellate. Leaves paripinnate, up to (1–)2–10-jugate. Leaflets mainly elliptic, 5–55 by 2–20 cm, mainly chartaceous; base (subcordate to) rounded to acute; apex (emarginate to) obtuse to acuminate; glabrous to hairy on both sides. Inflorescences up to 70 cm long, sparsely to densely brown pilose when dry. Flowers sweetly scented, white to light yellow. Sepals 5, ovate to obovate, 1.2–7 by 1.2–6 mm. Petals 5, ovate to elliptic to oblong, 2.2–10 by 1.2–4 mm, claw 0.5–2(–4) mm long; scales 2, in Thailand well-developed, seldom crested. Disc flat. Stamens mostly 8; filaments 1.5–6.5 mm long; anthers 0.8–2.5 mm long. Ovary 3-locular (Thailand). Fruits yellowish, greyish or greyish pink, sessile, 1.5–5 cm in diam., not lobed, not wrinkled when dry, densely short pilose outside when young, pilose to glabrous within. Seeds shiny brown to black; hilum small.

description: Branches glabrous, pale lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 1.3–2.7 cm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic to oblong, 5.5–14 x 2.3–5.7 cm, apex abruptly short blunt acuminate, base rounded to cuneate; 4–7 pairs of secondary veins, often with somewhat prominent tertiary veins perpendicular to the midrib, oblique to the secondary veins, sometimes obscure. Inflorescences robust, axillary along stems; to 5 cm long. Sepals ovate, 2–2.5 x 1.2–2.1 mm, apex obtuse to rounded; ciliate, colleters usually present. Corolla yellow or orange; tube 4.2–7 mm long; lobes 3–4 mm long, ovate, rounded; glabrous outside, pubescent in lower part inside. Stamens inserted at ca 3–4.4 mm from base; anthers ca 3 x 0.7 mm. Ovary ca 1.1 mm long; style + pistil head ca 2 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid to pear-shaped; to 3.5 cm long, 2 cm diameter. Seeds usually only 2; ca 1.2 x 0.9 cm.

description: Perennial herb. Stems prostrate, rooting at nodes, upper part and branches ascending, 6–50 cm, fulvous pilose; branches slender, often leafy only at apex. Leaves opposite, the 2 apical pairs crowded; petiole ½–⅓ the length of the blade, narrowly winged; blade ovate to broadly ovate or suborbicular, (0.7–)1.4–3(4.5) x (0.6)–1.3–2.2(–3) cm, base subrounded or shortly attenuate, apex acute or obtuse, strigillose, rarely glabrescent; glandular dots many, chiefly near the margin, reddish or becoming black; lateral nerves 2–4 pairs; veins inconspicuous. Inflorescence a terminal shortened head-like raceme, 2–4-flowered, rarely with solitary flowers in axils of the leaf pairs below the inflorescence. Pedicel very short or to 2 mm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, 5–8.5 x 1–1.5 mm, sparsely pubescent abaxially. Corolla yellow, dull red at base of inner side; tube 2–3 mm; lobes ovate-elliptic to oblong, 7–8 x 3–6.5 mm, acute or obtuse, with red or black glandular dots. Filaments connate into a 2.5 mm tube at base, free parts 2.5–4.5 mm. Anthers oblong, ca 1.5 mm, opening by lateral slits. Ovary hairy; style 5–7 mm. Capsule subglobose, 3–4 mm in diameter.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Perennial herb, 15–30 cm tall. Stems slender, ascending, usually branched from base, with multicellular hairs. Leaves opposite; petiole 4–8 mm, narrowly winged; blade ovate, 1.5–2.8 x 1–1.6 cm, base cuneate or subrounded, apex acute, strigillose and with scattered reddish minute glands on both surfaces. Flowers solitary in axils of leaves. Pedicel 2–4 mm, densely pubescent. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, ca 7 mm, accrescent to 1 cm in fruit, apex acuminate-subulate, densely pubescent, with reddish glands. Corolla yellow; tube ca 2 mm; lobes ovate-oblong, 6 x 2.5–3 mm, apex acute, with scattered reddish glandular dots. Filaments connate into a ca 1 mm tube at base, free parts 2.5–3.5 mm. Anthers ovoid, ca 1 mm, opening by lateral slits. Ovary pubescent; style ca 4 mm. Capsule subglobose, brown, ca 4 mm in diameter.

description: Perennial herb, 40–90 cm tall, glabrous throughout. Stem erect, with raised lines descending from the base of leaf petioles, usually much branched. Leaves alternate, sometimes subopposite; petiole 1–4 cm, narrowly winged; blade lanceolate, to elliptic lanceolate, 6–13 x 1.5–4 cm, base cuneate, apex acute or acuminate, ± membranous when dry, with scattered black glandular dots or short stripes on both surfaces, especially near the margin. Racemes terminal, 10–25 cm; bracts subulate, 2–3 mm. Pedicel 2–9 mm, lengthening to 10–18 mm in fruit. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes narrowly lanceolate, 3–4 mm, glandular ciliate, with black glandular stripes externally. Corolla white or tinged purple; tube ca 1.5 mm; lobes oblong-spathulate, 1–2.5 mm, apex rounded. Stamens long-exserted; filaments adnate to base of corolla lobes; anthers ovoid, purple, ca 1 mm. Ovary ovoid; style slender, ca 5 mm. Capsule globose or slightly depressed, 3–4 mm in diameter.

description: Perennial herb, 4–25 cm tall, with numerous rather thick stringy roots. Stems several from a collar; erect or ascending-erect, simple or branched from base, densely covered with multicellular hairs. Leaves opposite or alternate on the upper part of stem, subsessile or with petiole 2–3 mm; blade elliptic to suborbicular, 1–2.5 x 0.8–1.8 cm, base cuneate or subrounded, apex rounded, rarely acute, covered with multicellular hairs on both surfaces. Flowers solitary in axils of upper leaves; pedicel 1–2.5 cm, usually equalling the subtending leaves, ascending-erect, recurved in fruit. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, 4–5 mm, apex acuminate, pubescent abaxially. Corolla yellow; tube ca 1 mm; lobes obovate-elliptic, 4–6.5 x 4–5 mm, apex rounded, with pellucid glands. Filaments connate into a 1 mm ring at base, free parts ca 2 mm. Anthers ovoid, ca 1 mm, opening by lateral slits. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3.5 mm. Capsule subglobose, brown, ca 3 mm in diameter.

description: Perennial herb, 20–40 cm high. Stems erect, glabrous, ± costellate, usually branched from base. Leaves alternate; petiole ½–⅓ length of the blade; blade ovate or ovate-lanceolate, 12–25 x 5–8 mm, apex acute and ± cartilaginous apiculate, base attenuate, margin ± undulate, sparsely bristly on both surfaces; lateral nerves 3–4 pairs, veins inconspicuous. Flowers solitary in axils of leaves. Pedicel slender, 10–12 mm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes linear-lanceolate, 4–5.5 x 1 mm, glabrous or sometimes sparsely bristly along the margin. Corolla yellow; tube ca 0.8 mm; lobes ovate-oblong, 3.7–5 x 2.5 mm, apex obtuse. Filaments connate into a 0.4 mm ring at base, free parts 1–1.5 mm. Anthers ovoid-oblong, ca 1 mm, opening by lateral slits. Ovary glabrous; style ca 2.5 mm. Capsule globose, ca 3 mm in diameter, 5-valved.

description: Perennial herb, glabrous throughout. Stem erect, 20–35 cm high, angular; young parts glandular. Leaves alternate; petiole ca 1 cm, ± glandular; blade elliptic or lanceolate, 3–5 x 1–2 cm, base attenuate, decurrent, tapering to apex, margin narrow revolute; lateral nerves 4–5 pairs, ± impressed adaxially, prominent abaxially. Flowers axillary, solitary. Pedicel slender, 2–3 cm, ± thickened towards apex, sparsely glandular. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes ovate-lanceolate, 5 x 1.5 mm, sparsely glandular outside. Corolla yellow, deeply lobed; lobes elliptic or oblong, 10–12 x 5 mm, apex rounded. Filaments connate into a ring at base, free parts ca 1 mm. Anthers ca 7 mm, opening by apical pores. Ovary ovoid; style ca 7 mm. Capsule whitish, 5–7 mm in diameter, 5-valved.

description: Perennial herb, 20–55 cm high, aromatic when dry. Stem erect, angular, simple or slightly branched, glandular at apex. Leaves alternate, ± evenly distributed on stem; petiole very short or up to 1.5 cm; blade lanceolate, 2.5–6.5 x 0.7–1.7 cm, base attenuate, tapering to apex, margin obscurely undulate, glabrous or sparsely setulose on adaxial surface. Flowers axillary, solitary. Pedicel filiform, 2.5–3.5 cm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes ovate, ca 2.5 mm, copiously covered with minute glands within. Corolla pale yellow, deeply lobed; lobes narrowly oblong, 4–5 x 1.6–1.8 mm, ± obtuse at apex. Filaments connate into a 0.5 mm ring at base, free parts very short. Anthers 3–4 mm opening by apical pores. Style filiform, ca 4 mm. Capsule globose, ivory white, ca 3 mm in diameter, exceeding the calyx.

description: Annual herb to 60 cm high, with numerous fibrous roots. Stem erect, to 7 mm diam, at base, distinctly 4-angled, usually much branched. Leaves alternate, subsessile or with petiole to 1 cm; blade lanceolate or elliptic-lanceolate, 3–11 x 0.5–2.8 cm, tapering to both ends, becoming yellowish brown when dry, adaxially ± setulose, abaxially glabrous, midrib and lateral nerves prominent; reticulation of veins inconspicuous, with scattered minute glands on both surfaces. Flowers solitary in axils of median and upper leaves. Pedicel slender, 2–4 cm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes ovate-elliptic, 3–4 mm, apex acuminate, 7–9-nerved, margin ± membranous, often with stalked glands. Corolla yellow; tube ca 2 mm; lobes elliptic-obovate, 4–6 mm, apex obtuse. Filaments connate into a 0.5 mm ring at base, free parts ca 2.2 mm, flattened. Anthers 2.5–3 mm, opening by lateral slits. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3 mm. Capsule slightly depressed-globose, light brown, ca 5 mm in diameter, 5-valved.

description: Annual herb, 25–50 cm tall, glabrous. Stems arcuately erect or ascending, simple or branched from base, weakly 4-angled, with scattered black glandular dots. Leaves alternate, occasionally opposite at base of stem; petiole ¼–⅔ length of blade, narrowly winged; blade ovate or rhomboid-ovate, rarely ovate-lanceolate, 1.5–5 x 1–1.3 cm, base shortly attenuate to subrounded, rarely cuneate, apex acute, membranous when dry, with scattered dark purple or black glandular stripes near margin or along midrib. Racemes terminal, (5–)7–20 cm. Bracts subulate, usually ½ length of pedicel, rarely equalling it. Pedicel 5–12 mm, slightly lengthening in fruit. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 3 mm, apex acute, margin membranous, with black glandular stripes. Corolla white or pink; tube ca 2 mm; lobes spathulate or oblong-obovate, 4–4.5 x 1.6–2 mm, apex obtuse. Stamens long-exserted; filaments adnate to base of corolla lobes, free parts to 6 mm. Ovary sparsely puberulous; style ca 7 mm. Capsule subglobose, ca 4 mm in diameter.

description: Perennial herb, glabrous throughout. Stems flagelliform erect base, to 100 cm long, 4-angled, winged on the ridges. Leaves opposite; petiole 0.5–1 cm, sparsely glandular; blade ovate, 3–6 x 1.5–3.5 cm, apex acute, base cuneate to subrounded, sparsely glandular on lower surface; lateral nerves 3–4 pairs; veins obscure. Flowers solitary in axils of leaves. Pedicel slender, 2–2.5 cm, glabrous ± thickened at apex. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, 8 x 2 mm. Corolla yellow; tube ca 3 mm; lobes elliptic ca 8 x 4.5 mm, apex rounded. Filaments connate into a ring at base, free parts ca 0.75 mm. Anthers ca 2.5 mm, opening by short slits; style ca 5 mm. Capsule globose, 5–6 mm in diameter, 5-valved.

description: Annual herb, 5–30 cm high. Stems slender, erect or arcuate at base, striate or slightly angular, usually with a few branches above middle. Leaves spirally arranged, crowded towards apex of stem; petiole 0.5–1 cm; leaf blade lanceolate, 1.5–4.5 x 0.5–1 cm, base cuneate-attenuate, apex acute or shortly acuminate, strigillose on adaxial surface and mainly so along the midrib on abaxial surface; lateral nerves 5–7 pairs, veins invisible. Flowers solitary in axils of upper leaves. Pedicel slender, 2.5–4.5 cm, glabrous. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes oblong-lanceolate, 3–5 mm, shortly acuminate or acute. Corolla pale yellow, 3–4 mm, lobed to middle, lobes elliptic, acute. Filaments connate into a 0.5 mm ring at base, free parts 1.5–2.5 mm. Anthers basifixed, erect, ca 0.5 mm. Ovary glabrous; style 2–3 mm. Capsule slightly shorter than calyx, 5-valved.

description: Perennial herb. Stem erect, 10–30 cm tall, terete, puberulous. Leaves alternate, confined to upper ⅓ of stem; petiole 1–2.5 cm; leaf blade ovate or ovate-elliptic, 4–10 x 2–6 cm, base cuneate-attenuate to obtuse, apex acute or slightly acuminate, margins ciliate, greyish brown pilose and sparsely glandular on both surfaces; lateral nerves 4–5 pairs; veins indistinct. Racemes corymbiform, axillary, 2–8-flowered; peduncle 4–10 cm, pilose; bracts lanceolate, ca 5 mm, ciliate; pedicel 5–10 mm, pilose. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 5 x 2–2.5 mm, pilose. Corolla yellow; tube ca 3 mm; lobes ovate or elliptic, 4–5.5 x 4 mm, apex rounded. Filaments ca 2 mm, connate into a short ring at base. Anthers ca 2 mm, opening by apical pores. Ovary glabrous, style ca 3 mm. Capsule not known.

description: Annual herb. Stem erect, to 40 cm high, simple or weakly branched, 4-angled or narrowly winged on the upper part. Leaves alternate; petiole ca 11 cm; blade ovate lanceolate, ca 4.5 x 1.5 cm, base attenuate, apex acuminate, margin entire, with scattered black glands on both surfaces; lateral nerves 3–6 pairs, prominent on abaxial surface. Flowers solitary in axils of upper leaves. Pedicel 1.5–2.5 cm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes linear-lanceolate, ca 4.5–5 x 0.75 mm, with black glandular stripes. Corolla white; tube ca 1 mm; lobes ovate-elliptic, ca 2–3 x 1 mm, apex obtuse. Filaments very short, adnate to base of corolla lobes. Anthers ovoid, ca 0.5 mm, opening by slits. Ovary glabrous; style ca 2.5 mm. Capsule globose, ca 4 mm in diameter, 5-valved.

description: Perennial herb, 15–35 cm tall. Stems ascending from the prostrate base, often branched above, greyish brown pubescent. Leaves opposite, the 2-uppermost pairs crowded; petiole ⅓–½ length of the blade, narrowly winged, pilose; blade ovate or elliptic-ovate, 1.5–4 x 1–2.2 cm, base broadly cuneate, apex acute, with multicellular hairs on both surfaces. Flowers in a loose or compact head-like cluster, 2–4-flowered. Pedicel 3–8 mm, densely pubescent. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, 6–7 mm, pilose. Corolla yellow; tube ca 2 mm; lobes elliptic or elliptic-lanceolate, 9–12 mm, acute, without coloured glandular dots. Filaments connate into a 0.25 mm tube at base, free parts 2–3 mm. Anthers 1.6–1.8 mm, opening by lateral slits. Ovary hairy on the top; style ca 7 mm. Capsule globose, shorter than the persistent calyx.

description: Branchlets densely puberulent becoming gradually glabrous. Leaves: petiole 5–11 mm long; blade coriaceous, ovate, oblong or elliptic, 3.1–11.5 x 0.9–4.2 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base rounded to cuneate; 13–22 pairs of secondary veins, slightly raised above or not; puberulent on petiole and on midrib beneath, becoming glabrous with age. Inflorescence axillary and terminal forming a panicle; to 13 cm long; puberulent. Sepals strongly imbricate; ovate, 1.5–3.5 x 1.1–1.7 mm, apex acute to rounded; puberulent, ciliate. Corolla white, mouth orange; long and narrow in bud with head not wider than tube; tube 8–15 mm long, pubescent outside and inside; lobes 5.8–11 mm long, narrowly oblong, much longer than wide, + symmetrical, pubescent outside and inside; corona 0.3–0.9 mm long, sparsely puberulent. Stamens inserted at 2.5–3.5 mm from base; anthers 1–1.7 x 0.4–0.5 mm. Ovary 0.9–1.5 mm long; style 0.7–1.7 mm long; pistil head 1.3–1.8 mm long. Fruit globose; 4–6.2 cm diameter. Seeds 10.2–11.5 x 6.5–7.6 x 2.8–3.2 mm.

description: Branchlets glabrous, puberulent around nodes or, rarely, puberulent all over when very young. Leaves: petiole 5–11 mm long; blade coriaceous, narrowly ovate, elliptic, oblong or narrowly obovate, 3.7–22 x 0.8–7.5 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded to cuneate; 10–23 pairs of secondary veins, slightly raised above, glabrous or sparsely puberulent on very young petioles. Inflorescence axillary and terminal forming a panicle; to 4 cm long; puberulent. Sepals strongly imbricate; ovate, 1.5–2.8 x 1.4–2.3 mm, apex obtuse to rounded; puberulent or glabrous, ciliate. Corolla white or yellow; tube 5–8.3 mm long, puberulent outside, densely pubescent inside; lobes 3–4.6 mm long, obovate, about as long as wide, asymmetrical to the left as viewed from inside, puberulent or glabrous; corona fleshy, 1.1–1.9 mm long, 2-lobed, pubescent. Stamens inserted at 2.4–4 mm from base; anthers 1.4–1.7 x 0.4–0.6 mm. Ovary 0.9–1.4 mm long; style 0.9–1.9 mm long; pistil head 1.2–1.9 mm long. Fruit ovoid to globose, 3.5–10 cm long, 2.7–5.4 cm wide. Seeds 11–17 x 7–11 x 2 mm.

description: Branchlets glabrous. Leaves: petiole 5–8 mm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, 5.5–11.6 x 1.5–3.7 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; 12–18 pairs of secondary veins; glabrous. Inflorescence short, axillary; to 1.7 cm long; glabrous. Sepals ovate, 1.3 x 0.9–1.1 mm, apex rounded; glabrous, ciliate. Corolla tube 4.3–5.5 mm long, glabrous outside, pubescent inside; lobes 2.3–2.7 mm long, about as long as wide; corona 0.8 mm long, 2-lobed. Stamens inserted at 2.3–2.8 mm from base; anthers 1.6 x 0.3–0.6 mm. Ovary 1.1 mm long; style 0.7–0.8 mm long; pistil head 0.8 mm long. Fruit globose; 6.6–7.4 x 5.5–7.5 cm. Seeds 12–15 x 6–7 mm.

description: Shrubs to trees up to 25 m; bark red-brown to greyish. Leaves (1 or) 2–6-jugate. Leaflets ovate (to elliptic), 5–40 by 1–15 cm, index 2–5(–8), parchment-like to coriaceous, usually dull above when dry; base rounded or angular; apex (emarginate to) rounded to acuminate; glabrous on both sides; midrib angular above (to locally or seldom completely rounded). Inflorescences up to 40 cm long. Flowers white to yellowish, fragrant, small. Sepals: triangular, 0.75–2 by 1–2 mm, ± completely puberulous outside. Petals usually 5, reduced, up to 2 by 1 mm, not clawed. Stamens 7 or 8; filaments 3–4 mm long, partly pilose; anthers less than 0.5 mm long. Fruits red, (0.8–)1–2(–3) by 0.4–1.4 cm, usually with 1 seed; stipe 2–11 mm high. Seeds shiny dark brown, up to 8(–12) mm long; arillode bluish. Cotyledons with a strongly curved suture between them.
