description: Shrubs or trees up to 10(–30) m high; bark brownish to grey-brown. Leaves 1–3 (or 4-)jugate. Leaflets ovate to usually elliptic, 4–26 by 1.5–10 cm, index 2–4.5, parchment-like to subcoriaceous, usually shiny above when dry; base rounded or angular; apex (emarginate to) rounded to acuminate; glabrous on both sides; midrib rounded above to locally (to completely) angular. Inflorescences up to 25 cm long. Flowers greenish tinged white, small. Sepals triangular, 0.65–2 by 0.5–1 mm, green, glabrous to subpilose in lower half outside. Petals absent. Stamens (6–)8 (9); filaments up to 4 mm long, white, glabrous; anthers less than 0.5 mm long, tan. Fruits red, 7–17(–20) mm long, usually with 1 seed, stipe 2–14 mm high. Seeds shiny dark brown to black-dark purple, up to 7 mm long; arillode bluish. Cotyledons with a straight to slightly curved suture between them.

description: (Shrubs to) trees up to 40 m high; bark brown, with minute lenticels; young branchlets densely pilose. Leaves (1–)2–9(–13)-jugate; young rachises densely pilose. Leaflets elliptic, 6–35 by 1.8–12.5 cm, coriaceous to chartaceous; base acute to broadly rounded; apex rounded to acuminate; domatia absent; glabrous to hairy above, usually pilose underneath. Inflorescences mostly in upper leaf axils, (terminal or) pseudo terminal, also rami- or cauliflorous, often long pendulous spikes or racemes. Flowers greenish to whitish or yellowish, small, slightly scented. Sepals hardly to up to halfway connate, lobes deltoid, 1.1–2.5 mm high. Petals 0(-5), shorter than calyx. Stamens (4–)7 or 8 (or 9); filaments white or pinkish, anthers yellow. Ovary 2(–4)-locular. Fruits red; lobes ellipsoid (to globular), 2–4 by 2–3 cm, covered with up to 2 cm long spines; wall coriaceous, thin.

description: (Seldom shrubs to) trees up to 30 m high, sometimes monoecious; bark smooth; young branches subglabrous. Leaves 1–4 (or 5)-jugate; young rachises subglabrous at most. Leaflets ovate (to elliptic), 6.5–30 by 2–8 cm, stiff; base rounded to acute; apex obtuse to acute; domatia present; mainly glabrous above, subsericeous underneath. Inflorescences terminal and in upper leaf axils. Flowers white (or yellowish or greenish), small, fragrant, rich in nectar. Sepals slightly (to up to halfway connate), lobes deltoid, 1.3–2.6 mm high. Petals 0–6, 1.4–2 mm long, usually longer than sepals, sides woolly. Stamens 7–10; filaments white; anther light yellow. Ovary 2(–4)-locular. Fruits red; lobes ellipsoid, 2–3 by 1.5–2.25 cm, warty; wall coriaceous, ca 0.5 mm thick.

description: (Shrubs to) trees up to 44 m high; bark dark to red-brown to greyish, also whitish, greenish or blackish, smooth or with small lenticels (to a bit scaly); young branches subglabrous. Leaves 1–5(–8)-jugate; young rachises subglabrous at most. Leaflets ± elliptic, 5–22 by 2–10.5 cm, papyraceous; base acute to attenuate to rounded; apex slightly emarginate to rounded (to acuminate); domatia usually present; (sub)glabrous above, variably short-pilose underneath. Inflorescences axillary, together pseudo terminal (to terminal). Flowers white to yellowish or greenish, small, odourless or fragrant. Sepals slightly to up to halfway connate, lobes deltoid, 1–2.1 mm high. Petals 0(–4), up to 1.6 mm long, including the 1.1 mm long claw, (sub)glabrous outside, woolly inside. Stamens (4) 5–8 (9); filaments white, anthers yellow to red. Ovary 2(–4) locular. Fruits red or yellowish green with red, acute spines, up to 2 cm long; lobes ellipsoid to subglobular, up to 6 by 3.5 cm; wall coriaceous, up to 2.5 mm thick.

description: Trees up to 24 m high; bark grey to brown, smooth; young branches subglabrous. Leaves 1–6-jugate; young rachises subglabrous at most. Leaflets (ovate to) elliptic (to obovate), 5–18.5 by 1.5–4.3 cm, stiff; base rounded to acute to attenuate; apex acuminate; domatia present; (sub)glabrous above, usually shortly sericeous underneath. Inflorescences (pseudo-)terminal or axillary. Flowers white to pinkish, small. Sepals up to 20% connate, lobes deltoid, 2–3 mm high. Petals 0–5, (obovate-)elliptic, 1.6–2.3 mm long, at least lower half woolly-ciliate. Stamens (7 or) 8; filaments white. Ovary 2(–4)-locular. Fruits red; lobes (curved obovoid when young to) ellipsoid, ca 2.5 by 1.5 cm, covered with short, up to 1(–1.5) cm long, blunt spines; wall coriaceous, barely 1 mm thick.

description: Trees up to 40 m high; bark usually greyish to white, also brownish to reddish, smooth or with minute lenticels (or fissured and flaking); young branches subglabrous. Leaves 1–3(–5)-jugate; young rachises subglabrous at most. Leaflets elliptic to obovate, 5.8–22 by 2.8–9 cm, parchment-like; base usually attenuate (to rounded to acute); apex obtusely to acutely acuminate; domatia absent; glabrous above, (sub)glabrous underneath. Stamens 4–6. Ovary 1-locular. Fruits red; lobe ± flattened-ellipsoid, 2–2.8 by 1.3–1.8 by 1–1.3 cm, ± smooth; style remnant present as hook above stipe; stipe 2–3 mm high; wall coriaceous, 1–1.5 mm thick.

description: Trees up to 36 m high; bark red, smooth; young branches subglabrous. Leaves 1–5-jugate; young rachises subglabrous at most. Leaflets ovate to obovate, 4.5–16 by 2–6 cm, stiff; base acute to rounded (to attenuate); apex (seldom emarginate to) rounded (to acuminate); domatia absent; sparsely puberulous on midrib to glabrous above, the same to sparsely shortly sericeous underneath. Inflorescences pseudo-terminal to terminal. Flowers greenish to whitish or yellowish, small. Sepals nearly free, lobes deltoid, 1–1.8 mm high. Petals 2–5, elliptic, 0.8–1.3 mm long, completely woolly. Stamens (7 or) 8. Ovary 24–4)-locular. description: Trees up to 10(–36) m high; bark usually reddish, brownish or greyish, usually smooth or with minute lenticels; young branches subglabrous. Leaves 1–7-jugate; young rachises subglabrous at most. Leaflets (ovate to) elliptic (to obovate), 4–120 by 1.8–11 cm, papyraceous; base acute or obtuse to rounded to attenuate in lower leaflets; margins convex, often rolled up when dry; apex mostly acuminate; domatia present; glabrous to puberulous on midrib above, usually short hairy to glabrous underneath. Inflorescences axillary, partly together pseudo-terminal. Flowers pale green or white, small, slightly scented. Sepals hardly to up to halfway connate, lobes deltoid, 1–2.75 mm high. Petals absent. Stamens 5–8; filaments white, anthers light yellow. Ovary 2(–4)-locular. Fruits yellow, red or green; lobes ellipsoid to subglobular, 4–6.5 by 2.5–5 cm, covered with short, up to 1(–1.5) cm long, blunt spines; wall coriaceous, up to 7 mm thick.

description: Shrub or small tree to 6m. Branchlets puberulent or glabrous. Leaves: petiole short; blade coriaceous, narrowly elliptic, 5–21 x 1–3.5 cm, apex acute or acuminate, base cuneate; veins straight and obscure; puberulent or glabrous. Corolla white, pink, red or yellow, showy; tube 12–22 mm long; lobes 13–30 mm long, rounded. Stamens with anthers 4–6 x 1.2–1.7 mm without appendages, appendages 7–9 mm long; filaments and outside of anthers pubescent. Ovary 1.5–2 mm long; style + pistil head 7.5–13 mm long. Fruit 7.5–17.5 cm long, 1–1.3 cm wide. Seeds 4–7 x 1.5–2 x 1 mm; coma 9–12 mm long.

description: Shrub or tree to 10 m tall. Branchlets glabrous, angled; when older bearing elongated lenticels. Leaves in whorls of 3 or opposite; petiole 1.8–5 cm long; blade subcoriaceous to coriaceous, spathulate, 5.5–27 x 3.5–11.9 cm, apex rounded to obtuse sometimes apiculate, base cuneate; major secondary veins with weaker parallel veins 15–28 pairs; glabrous. Inflorescence axillary and terminal; flowers clustered; 3.6–12.6 cm long; glabrous; pedicels 1.8–4.6 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1.6–2.2 x 0.7–1.6 mm, apex obtuse; glabrous. Corolla white; tube 4–5.1 mm long; lobes 4.3–6.5 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent inside. Stamens inserted at 3.3–3.5 mm from corolla base; filaments 0.5–0.7 mm long; anthers 1.2–1.4 x 0.4–0.5 mm. Disk 0.2 mm long. Ovary 0.8–1 mm long; style + pistil head 1.1–2.6 mm long. Fruits ovoid; 6.1–7 cm long, 3.2–4 cm diameter. Seeds ca 3.8 x 2.5 x 1.3 cm.

description: Branches pubescent or glabrous. Leaves: petiole 1–4.6 mm long; blade papery, elliptic or ovate, 1.5–14 x 0.7–5.3 cm, apex acuminate or rarely acute, base cuneate; secondary veins 3–6 pairs. Inflorescence 2–16 cm long; forming a terminal panicle or having shorter cymes scattered along stem; puberulent; many flowered. Sepals 0.5–1.1 x 0.4–0.7 mm; pubescent to glabrous. Corolla white, sometimes with some pink; tube 1.6–2.3 mm long; lobes 1.7–4 mm long; glabrous or pubescent on tube outside, glabrous inside. Stamens with anthers 0.8–1.4 x 0.3–0.4 mm, apex long acuminate. Disk of 5 separate lobes. Ovary 0.3–0.6 mm long, pubescent on top; style + pistil head 0.7–1.2 mm long. Fruit 12–27 cm long, 0.4–0.7 cm wide; glabrous. Seeds brown hirsute; elliptic, inrolled; 5.7–12 x 1.1–4 mm; coma 1.7–3.2 mm long.

description: Branches glabrous except for slight pubescence around nodes. Leaves: petiole 3–9 mm long; blade papery, elliptic, 3–9(–12.8) x 1.1–4.5(–6.2) cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 4–9 pairs. Inflorescence 5.5–11 cm long; pubescent; many flowered. Sepals 1–1.2 x 0.6–1 mm, pubescent. Corolla pinkish; tube 1–1.8 mm long; lobes 2.6–4.7 mm long; puberulent outside on tube and base of lobes; sparsely puberulent in a band at stamen level or glabrous inside. Stamens with anthers 1–1.4 x 0.2–0.4 mm. Disk 5-lobed. Ovary 0.3–0.8 mm long, densely pubescent on top; style + pistil head 1–1.3 mm long. Fruit weakly torulose; 37–90 cm long, 4–5 mm wide. Seeds 1.5–22 x 2.6–3 mm; coma 3–4.1 cm long.

description: (Shrubs to) trees up to 20 m high; bark brown, smooth. Leaves 3–5-jugate. Leaflets elliptic, 6–32 by 3–13 cm, coriaceous; base cuneate (terminal one) to rounded; margin dentate; apex emarginate to rounded (to acuminate); glabrous on both sides; midrib entirely sunken above, only groove visible. Inflorescences up to 60 cm long. Flowers white to pink, fragrant. Sepals 5, deltoid, 1–2.1 by 1.2–2.3 mm. Petals obtriangular, to suborbicular, 1–2 by 0.8–1.8 mm; scale 1–2 by 1.5–3.3 mm, hairs yellow. Stamens 7 or 8; filaments up to 3.5 mm long; anthers ca 0.5 mm high. Fruits greyish brown to red, 2–3 by 2.5–3.7 cm, densely spiny, glabrous.

description: (Shrubs to) trees up to 25 m high; bark brown, smooth. Leaves 2–4-jugate. Leaflets elliptic, 5–34 by 2–14.5 cm, thick papery; base acutely to rounded-attenuate; margin dentate; apex acuminate to caudate, often rounded in terminal leaflet; glabrous on both sides; midrib visible above. Inflorescences up to 28 cm long. Flowers white to yellow, fragrant. Sepals 5(–7), narrowly triangular, 1.2–2 by 0.5–1.8 mm. Petals variable, 1.2–2 by 0.8–1.7 mm; scale 1.5–2.5 by 1–2 mm. Stamens 7 or 8; filaments up to 4.2 mm long; anthers ca 0.5 mm high. Fruits dull brown to brownish black, 2.5–4 by 3–4.3 cm, densely to laxly spiny, glabrous to minutely hairy.

description: (Shrubs to) trees up to 20(–40) m high; bark greenish brown, smooth. Leaves 1–6-jugate. Leaflets 3–42 by 1.1–14 cm, thick papery; base narrowly cuneate to obtuse, attenuate or not; margin entire; apex rounded to acuminate; subglabrous on both sides; midrib visible above. Inflorescences up to 30 cm long. Flowers white to yellowish, fragrant. Sepals (4) 5 (6), deltoid, 0.8–2 by 0.5–1.8 mm. Petals variable, 1–2.5 by 0.7–2.7 mm; scale 1.1–2.2 by 1.2–3 mm. Stamens 5–8 (9); filaments up to 4 mm long; anthers ca 0.5 mm high. Fruits brown, yellow or grey, up to 7 cm in diam., laxly to densely spiny (or warty), glabrous.

description: Branches sparsely and minutely puberulent to glabrous; not lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 0.5–2.2(–4.7) cm long; blade papery, ovate to elliptic, 2.5–11.8(–23) x 1.1–6.3(–21) cm, apex acute to acuminate, base weakly cordate to obtuse; secondary veins 4–7(–10) pairs, glabrous or with few hairs beneath on midrib and petiole. Inflorescence 4.2–20 cm long; minutely puberulent. Sepals ovate, 1.3–3 x 0.9–1.7 mm, apex rounded to acuminate; puberulent. Corolla greenish or yellowish, sometimes with purple streaks; tube 2.4–4.6 mm long; lobes 3.1–5.8 mm long, lanceolate or oblong; shortly puberulent, especially on lobes, or glabrous outside, shortly puberulent on lobes inside, glabrous or sparsely pubescent inside tube. Stamens with filaments 2.1–3.8 mm long, strongly spiral around the style (in Thailand), glabrous or pubescent; anthers 2.6–3.8 x 0.5–0.7 mm. Disk of 5 separate deltoid lobes, 0.6–1.2 mm long. Ovary 0.7–1.7 mm long; style + pistil head 3–5 mm long. Fruit (5.2–)11.8–14.5(–21) cm long, 0.9–1.1(–1.4) cm wide. Seeds somewhat flattened or triangular in cross section; (9.5–)13.5–16(–24) x (1.2–)2–2.3(–3) mm; coma.(1.8–)3.3–3.9(–4.6) cm long.

description: Branches very sparsely puberulent or glabrous; not lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 1.6–4 cm long; blade papery to coriaceous, ovate or elliptic, 9–18.2 x 4.2–8.3 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded; secondary veins 6–7 pairs; glabrous or with sparse minute hairs all over beneath. Inflorescence 6.8–8 cm long; puberulent in upper parts. Sepals ovate, 1.5–2 x 1.1–1.5 mm, apex acute to acuminate; puberulent. Corolla white, greenish or yellowish; tube 2.7–3.8 mm long; lobes 3.6–3.8 mm long, ovate, apex acute; puberulent and papillose on lobes outside, densely long pubescent inside tube. Stamens with filaments 3.5–4 mm long, strongly bent; anthers 4.9–5 x 0.9–1 mm. Disk entire, 5 crenate; 1.1–1.4 mm long. Ovary of two very closely adnate carpels; 1–1.1 mm long; style + pistil head 3.4–3.9 mm long. Fruit 14.7–15.1 cm long, 8–9 mm wide. Seeds triangular in cross section; 11.2–14.2 x 1.9–2.2 mm; coma 2.1–4.5 cm long.

description: Branchlets minutely puberulent. Leaves: petiole 0.7–2.5 cm long; blade papery to coriaceous, elliptic, 3.9–15.7 x 0.9–7.9 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded to cuneate; secondary veins 5–8 pairs, ascending; sparsely puberulent on petiole and often also on abaxial midrib. Inflorescence robust, 3.3–10 cm long; puberulent. Sepals ovate to oblong, 1.6–2.7 x 1.3–1.7 mm, apex rounded to obtuse; puberulent. Corolla white to reddish, fleshy; buds tubular, head rounded, lobes strongly overlapping to the right; open corolla with erect lobes, tube 2.8–3.7 mm long; lobes 2.5–4.2 mm long, oblong, apex rounded to obtuse; glabrous to puberulent outside, glabrous inside except on filaments. Stamens inserted at 0.9–2.1 mm from corolla base, which is 0.2–0.6 of tube length; filaments strongly twisted but not wound around style, puberulent, 1.8–3.5 mm long; anthers 3–3.9 x 0.5–0.7 mm. Disk of 5 separate lobes, occasionally fused at base, oblong to narrowly triangular, apex acute, flat-topped or notched, 0.6–1 mm long. Ovary 0.8–1.6 mm long; style + pistil head 2.8–4.8 mm long. Fruit fusiform, thick walled, glabrous, 8–13.3 cm long, 1–1.4 cm wide. Seeds not seen.

description: Tree to 5 m. Leaves: petiole 3–7 cm long; blade coriaceous, obovate, 10–25.5 x 3.5–7.7 cm, apex rounded; 21–26 pairs of secondary veins. Inflorescence long pedunculate; 25–35 cm long. Sepals 1.7–1.9 x 2.5–3.1 mm. Corolla white with a yellow mouth; tube 1.7–2.3 cm long; lobes 2.3–6 cm long, narrowly obovate, rounded; glabrous outside, pubescent inside. Stamens inserted at ca 2 mm from corolla base; anthers ca 2.3 x 0.6 mm. Ovary ca 1.1 mm long, glabrous; style + pistil head 2.8 mm long. Fruit ca 17–18 cm long, ca 1.5–2 cm wide, somewhat laterally compressed. Seed grains ca 10 x 5 mm; wing ca 2 cm long.

description: Trees to 8 m tall. Leaves: petiole to 7 cm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, 14–34 x 6–8 cm, apex acuminate or acute, base cuneate to acute; secondary veins 30–40 pairs; glabrous. Sepals ca 1.1–1.8 x 1.3–2.5 mm. Corolla white, pink, wine red or yellow; tube 1.2–1.8 cm long; lobes 3–4.5 cm long, obovate, rounded; sparsely pubescent or glabrous outside, pubescent inside. Stamens inserted at ca 2 mm from corolla base; anthers ca 2.2 x 0.4 mm. Ovary semi-inferior, ca 0.9 mm long; glabrous; style + pistil head ca 1.9 mm. Fruit 10–16 cm long, 2–3 cm wide. Seed grains 1–1.5 cm long, wing 1.6–2.8 cm long.

description: Trees up to 50 m high; bark smooth to cracked, greyish brown to greyish; branchlets brownish (to blackish) when dry. Indumentum present in various parts. Leaves 4–13-jugate. Leaflets ovate to obovate, falcate, 6–32 by 2–13 cm, parchment like to coriaceous; base oblique; margin dentate or with minute teeth (glands); apex (acute to) acuminate; glabrous to variably hairy on both sides; nerves ending free in marginal teeth. Inflorescences up to 70 cm long. Flowers cream. Calyx variably connate, lobes 0.5–1.5 by 0.3–1.2 mm. Petals obtrapezoid, 0.4–1.3 by 0.3–1.6 mm. Stamens: filaments 2–6 mm long, white; anthers 0.5–1 mm long. Fruits red, 1.5–5 by 1–3 cm; not stipitate; lobes ellipsoid; wall basally 1 mm thick up to 7 mm in upper part. Seeds up to 2.5 by 1.5 cm.

description: Trees up to 40 m high; bark smooth or minutely lenticellate, brown with grey patches; branchlets blackish brown when dry. Indumentum mainly absent except for ovary and petals. Leaves 6–8-jugate. Leaflets elliptic, central ones falcate, 7.5–15 by 2.8–5.5 cm, chartaceous; base oblique; margin entire; apex acuminate; (sub)glabrous on both sides; nerves looped and closed near margin. Inflorescences up to 25 cm long. Flowers cream. Calyx 15–20% connate, lobes ca 1.5 by 0.75 mm. Petals obtrapezoid, ca 0.65 by 0.8–1 mm. Stamens: filaments ca 2.2 mm long; anthers ca 0.75 mm long. Fruits red to purple, ca 2 by 2 cm; not stipitate; lobes ellipsoid; wall basally 1 mm thick up to 7 mm in upper part. Seeds not observed.

description: Branches shortly tomentose to glabrous. Leaves: petiole 1–3.5 cm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, ovate to elliptic, 3.3–14 x 1.3–8 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded to weakly cordate; secondary veins 5–7 pairs; usually puberulent in abaxial secondary vein axils and often on abaxial and adaxial midrib. Inflorescence 10.5–27 cm long; glabrous to tomentose. Sepals ovate, 0.7–1.6 x 0.7–1.1 mm, apex acute to acuminate; puberulent to glabrous, ciliate. Corolla pink; tube 4–7 mm long; lobes 2–4.3 mm long; glabrous outside or, rarely, with 5 small pubescent patches at top of tube outside, inside pubescent on and below the filaments. Stamen: filaments 0.7–1.5 mm long; anthers 2–2.7 x 0.7–1 mm. Disk 1.5–2 mm long. Ovary 0.6–1.1 mm long; style + pistil head 4.5–6.6 mm long. Fruit 26–35 cm long, 2.3–2.5 mm wide; often somewhat spiral. Seeds 19–20 x 2.6–2.7 mm; coma 2.6–3.3 cm long.

description: Biennial herb. Stem ascending, 14–27 cm tall, reddish, with spreading multicellular hairs. Leaves alternate, crowded towards apex of stem; petiole about as long as blade, whitish pilose; blade ovate-oblong or oblong, 4–6 x 3–4 cm, apex obtuse, base shallowly cordate, margin ± sinuate; lobes irregularly dentate, whitish pilose above, densely so beneath. Scapes 7.5–15 cm, pilose. Umbels 3–4, superimposed, each 5–10- flowered. Bracts linear, 4–6 mm, glabrous. Pedicel 10–14 mm, glabrous. Calyx campanulate, ca 4 mm, white farinose, split to middle; lobes narrowly triangular, apex acute. Corolla pink; tube 4.5 mm, glabrous; limb ca 8 mm wide; lobes obcuneate, apex emarginate. Pin flowers: stamens inserted ca 1.5 mm above base of corolla tube; style ca 3 mm.

description: Perennial herb, efarinose, with a short comparatively stout rhizome. Leaves forming a spreading rosette; petiole 2.5–5 cm, thickly tawny pilose; blade ovate-elliptic to suborbicular, 3–5 x 2.5–4 cm, apex rounded, base distinctly cordate, margin ± undulate or irregularly crenulate, membranous when dry, softly pubescent above, markedly pilose below along all the nerves; midrib and 4–5 pairs of lateral nerves prominent beneath. Scapes slender, ca 5 cm, tawny pilose. Umbel solitary, 5–6-flowered. Bracts linear, 2 3 mm, sparsely pilose. Pedicels 5–7 mm, hairy. Calyx ca 5 mm, narrowly campanulate, 5-veined, hairy on the veins, split to a third into triangular lobes. Corolla funnel shaped, white, annulate, monomorphic; tube a little longer to 1.5 times as long as the calyx; limb ca 8 mm wide; lobes obovate, apex emarginate. Stamens with anthers 1.5 mm long, inserted near middle of corolla tube; style reaching the level of the stamens. Ovary ± pyriform, slightly thickened at apex.

description: Perennial herb. Leaves forming a basal rosette; petiole 2–7 cm, narrowly winged; leaf blade oblanceolate to elliptic-oblong, 6–12 x 2–4 cm, apex rounded, base attenuate, margin dentate to dentate-lobulate, efarinose, sparsely pilose above, with longer and denser hairs on all nerves beneath; lateral nerves 7–9 pairs, conspicuous beneath. Scapes ca 15 cm, pubescent, white farinose towards apex. Inflorescence initially capitate, soon elongating to short spicate, with 4–8 ± pendent flowers. Bracts linear to lanceolate, ca 4 mm. Calyx 5–6.5 mm, often copiously white farinose outside, split to middle; lobes ovate, 2–2.5 mm, apex acute. Corolla funnel-shaped, pale violet, 2–2.5 cm, finely farinose outside; basal cylindrical portion of the tube 0.8–1 cm, gradually expanded distally, limb to 2.8 cm wide; lobes broadly elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 9 x 6–8 mm, entire or 2–4 dentate at apex. Thrum flower: stamens inserted 5–7 mm above base of corolla tube; style 1.5 mm. Pin flower: stamens inserted 2 mm above base of corolla tube; style ca 8 mm.

description: Shrub to 2 m tall. Branchlets glabrous; strongly angled when young. Leaves: petiole 1–3.4 cm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, narrowly elliptic to oblanceolate, 12–29 x 4.2–9.5 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 12–25 pairs, arcuate ascending; glabrous. Inflorescence solitary, axillary or terminal; robust, flowers lax; 3.7–10 cm long, peduncle 1.4–4.4 cm long; glabrous; pedicels 2.8–6.5 mm long. Sepals ovate or lanceolate, 1.6–2.5 x 0.8–1.2 mm, apex acute to acuminate; glabrous, minutely ciliate or not. Corolla tube reddish or purplish, lobes white; tube 9.7–15.5 mm long; lobes 2.1–4 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and inside to just beneath the stamens. Stamens inserted at 8.5–9.1 mm from corolla base; filaments 0.4–0.6 mm long; anthers 1.2–2.1 x 0.4–0.7 mm. Disk 0.5–0.8 mm long. Ovary 1.4–2.2 mm long, carpels free up to the single style; style + pistil head 6.2–7.6 mm long. Fruits paired, free from each other; ovoid; 7–10.9 mm long, 4.4–5.8 mm wide. Seeds 6–7.1 x 2.5–3.9 mm.

description: Small shrub. Branchlets glabrous. Leaves: petiole 0.3–0.6 cm long; blade papery, elliptic, apex acuminate, 3.4–13 x 1.2–4 cm, base cuneate; secondary veins 6–12 pairs, arcuate ascending; glabrous. Inflorescence in a whorl; delicate, lax; 2.2–2.5 cm long, peduncle 1.2–1.3 cm long; glabrous, minutely papillate; pedicels 1.2–1.3 mm long. Sepals ovate, ca 1.1 x 0.7 mm, apex acute; glabrous. Corolla white; tube ca 2.7 mm long; lobes ca 1.1 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent inside to just beneath stamens. Stamens inserted at ca 2.4 mm from base; filaments ca 0.4 mm long; anthers ca 0.7 x 0.4 mm. Disk ca 0.5 mm long. Ovary ca 0.9 mm long, carpels connate at base; style + pistil head ca 1.6 mm long. Fruits paired, connate at base; each half mango shaped; 4.2–5.5 mm long, 3.6–4.6 mm wide. Seeds curved; ca 4.5 x 3.7 mm.

description: Low growing shrub. Branchlets glabrous; often angled. Leaves: petiole 1–1.9 cm long; blade papery, elliptic or obovate, 4.1–25 x 1.5–9.9 cm, apex acuminate, rarely to obtuse, base cuneate; secondary veins 7–16 pairs, arcuate ascending; glabrous. Inflorescence usually solitary, terminal; flowers clustered; 4.5–11.5 cm long, peduncle 3–7.8 cm long; glabrous; pedicels 2.2–6.5 mm long. Sepals ovate or lanceolate, 1.8–4.2 x 0.5–1.5 mm, apex acute to acuminate; glabrous. Corolla white, reddish, pinkish or purplish; tube 10.5–20 mm long; lobes 2–5.6 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and inside to just beneath stamens or in mouth and around stamens with a glabrous band between. Stamens inserted at 7.7–11.3 mm from base; filaments 0.5–1 mm long; anthers 1.2–1.7 x 0.5–0.7 mm. Disk 0.3–0.8 mm long. Ovary 0.8–1.6 mm long, carpels connate at base; style + pistil head 7.2–9.6 mm long. Fruits paired, connate at base; each half ovoid; 5.4–9 mm long, 4.2–4.7 mm wide. Seeds 4 x 2.8 mm.

description: Tree to 10 m. Branchlets glabrous; densely lenticellate when older. Leaves: petiole 0.7–2.8 cm long; blade coriaceous, elliptic, 4.5–21 x 2.1–6.4 cm, shortly acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 24–30 pairs, + straight, anastomosing into an intramarginal nerve; glabrous. Inflorescence in a whorl; robust, lax; (8–)15.4–21 cm long, peduncle 11–14.5 cm long; glabrous; pedicels 6.5–8 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1.5–1.7 x 1.2–2.2 mm, apex obtuse; glabrous. Corolla tube 4–4.5 mm long; lobes 1.5–1.8 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent inside to just beneath stamens. Stamens inserted at ca 2.8 mm from base; filaments. 0.5 mm long; anthers 0.7–1 x 0.5 mm. Disk 0.2–0.5 mm long. Ovary 0.8–1.2 mm long; syncarpous, bilocular; style + pistil head ca 1.8 mm long. Fruit of 2 hard separate endocarps surrounded by a single fleshy mesocarp; globose or indented on top; 9–24 mm diameter. Seeds 7.7–8.5 x 2–3.5 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree. Branchlets glabrous, often angled. Leaves: petiole 0.5–1 cm long; blade papery, elliptic, obovate or oblanceolate, 3.1–30.5 x 1–10.4 cm, apex acuminate, rarely to obtuse, base cuneate; secondary veins 9–18 pairs, arcuate ascending; glabrous. Inflorescence in a terminal whorl; delicate, lax; 2.2–12.4 cm long, peduncle 0–10 cm long; glabrous; pedicels 3.5–7.5 mm long Sepals ovate or lanceolate, 1.4–2.4 x 0.5–1 mm, apex acute to acuminate; glabrous, minutely ciliate or not. Corolla white or white and reddish; tube 9.3–18 mm long; lobes 2–4 mm long; glabrous outside, pubescent in mouth and inside to just beneath stamens. Stamens inserted at 5–10.4 mm from base; filaments 0.5–0.8 mm long; anthers 1.2–1.5 x 0.5–0.6 mm. Disk 0.4–1.1 mm long. Ovary 1.1–1.8 mm long, carpels completely free up to the single style; style + pistil head 4–9.5 mm long. Fruits paired, free from each other, or solitary; ovoid; 8.3–14 mm long, 4.5–5.5 mm wide. description: Trees up to 42 m high; bark greyish, flaking, cracked. Leaves (6–)8–13-jugate. description: Branchlets glabrous. description: Shrubs to trees up to 10(–15) m high. Leaves 4-jugate. description: Small shrub to 2 m. Branchlets sparsely puberulent, more rarely glabrous or densely puberulent. description: Shrub or small tree to 5 m high. Branches sparsely lenticellate; branchlets glabrous. description: Shrub or small tree to 4 m. Branches lenticellate; glabrous. description: Shrub or small tree. Branches lenticellate; glabrous. description: Shrub or small tree to 3 m. Branches glabrous. description: Branches minutely puberulent or glabrous when young; lenticellate or not. Leaves: petiole 0.8–2.2 cm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, elliptic, 3.3–8.8 x 1.8–3.9 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 3–6 pairs, pubescent on the underside in the axils of the secondary veins with the the midrib, occasionally glabrous; glands in leaf axils. Fruit fusiform to linear, not stipitate, divergent; 2.8–22 cm long, 4.9–8.5(–18) mm wide; densely lenticellate. Seeds 10.6–14.3 x 2.4–3.8; coma 2.9–5.5 cm long.

description: Leaves: petiole (5–)13–20(-30) mm; blade broadly elliptic, 10–17 x 5–9.5 cm, 1.6–2.1 x as long as wide, apex emarginate, rounded, apiculate or shortly acuminate, base obtuse, 7–9 pairs of secondary veins. description: Branches glabrous, lenticellate. description: Branches glabrous, lenticellate. description: Branchlets minutely and sparsely puberulent; lenticellate when older. description: Shrub or tree to 20 m. Branchlets tomentose or puberulent, becoming glabrous and lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 2–7 mm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, elliptic, 2.2–14 x 0.9–6.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate to obtuse; secondary veins 7–16 pairs; tomentose or puberulent abaxially and adaxially. Inflorescence 3.5–7 cm long; tomentose or puberulent; pedicels 5–11 mm long. Sepals ovate, 1–2.7 x 1.5–2.1 mm, apex rounded to obtuse; tomentose or puberulent; colleters large and wide. Corolla greenish, white or yellowish; subrotate; tube 3.2–6.5 mm long; lobes 7.7–14.5 mm long, oblong, apex obtuse or rounded; pubescent-papillose on lobes inside and outside and, sometimes, on top of corolla tube outside, glabrous in tube. Corona of antepetalous and alternipetalous lobes, pubescent on outside of lobes, wide and frequently overlapping; antepetalous lobes adnate to corolla for about half length, much shorter than stamens, crenate, 2–4.8 mm long; alternipetalous lobes notched, 1.2–3.5 mm long. Stamens inserted at corolla mouth; filaments 0.4–0.7 mm long; anthers 4.7–6 x 1.1–1.5 mm, pubescent on both surfaces. Ovary 1.1–2 mm long, glabrous, carpels connate; style + pistil head 6–7.7 mm long. Fruit of connate follicles, splitting into two at dehiscence; 9.3–34 cm long, 0.6–1.8 cm wide; glabrous or, rarely, locally minutely puberulent; lenticellate. Seeds linear; 15.8–16.5 x 1.8–2.3 mm; coma 5.6 cm long.

description: Tree to 7 m. Branchlets tomentose, becoming glabrous and lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 5–8 mm long; blade papery, elliptic to obovate, 7.3–17.8 x 4.3–8.3 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate; secondary veins 14–18 pairs; tomentose abaxially, punctate adaxially. Corona of antepetalous lobes only, very broad and connate at base; adnate to tube for about third of length; pubescent on back; crenate or flat-topped; 2.5–2.9 mm long. Stamens inserted at corolla mouth; filaments 1.3 mm long; anthers 7.3–7.4 x 1.5 mm, pubescent on both surfaces. Ovary 1.5 mm long, glabrous, carpels free; style + pistil head 6.1 mm long. description: Shrub to 2 m tall. Branchlets glabrous or sparsely puberulent, becoming glabrous and lenticellate. Leaves: petiole 2–11 mm long; blade papery to subcoriaceous, elliptic, oblong or obovate, 3.6–26.5 x 2–8.1 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate to rounded; 6–14 pairs of secondary veins, puberulent abaxially, only on midrib and secondary veins or, rarely, glabrous and then both surfaces punctate. Inflorescence 2.5–4.2 cm long; sparsely puberulent or glabrous; pedicels 4–5.5 mm long, robust. Sepals ovate, 1.3–3 x 1.5–1.9 mm, apex acute to obtuse; sparsely puberulent or glabrous, ciliate; colleters wide and large. Corolla orange, pink or reddish; infundibuliform; tube 6–13.2 mm long; lobes 10–23 mm long, ovate, apex acuminate to obtuse; pubescent-papillose on lobes and sometimes top of tube outside, pubescent-papillose on lobes inside, glabrous in tube. Corona of antepetalous and alternipetalous lobes; antepetalous lobes adnate to the corolla, 1.5–3.7 mm long; alternipetalous lobes 0.6–2.2 mm long. Ovary 1.6–2.5 mm long, glabrous, of two separate carpels; style + pistil head 3–4.7 mm long. Fruit of paired follicles; 13–30 cm long, 3.5–5 mm wide; glabrous; not lenticellate. description: Shrub or tree to 10 m tall. Branchlets glabrous, becoming lenticellate. description: Shrub or small tree to 5 m tall. Branchlets puberulent, becoming glabrous and lenticellate. description: Shrub or tree to 15 m tall. Branchlets tomentose; becoming glabrous and lenticellate. description: Trees up to 25(–40) m high; bark black to brown to greyish, smooth, lenticellate or with large flakes. Leaves 1–2(–3)-jugate. description: Trees up to 14 m high; bark light brown, slightly rough. Leaves 3–5-jugate.
